---
title: "Figure panels and Supplementary Tables for the CAD isoform manuscript"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

This script turns the exported results of scripts 01–09 into the figure panels and
Supplementary Tables of the manuscript. It performs no new analysis: every number it
plots or tabulates is read from a results file written upstream, from a deposited
experimental source-data workbook, or from the long-read catalog itself, so that
re-knitting the figures can never silently change an analysis result. Figures are
written as vector SVG and 400-dpi PNG at their final size, one file per panel and
named for the panel it feeds, so that the published figure files and this script can
be cross-checked by name. A single junction master table (one row per distinct CAD
sQTL junction, n = 355) is assembled first because every Fig. 4 panel and
Supplementary Table 13 report different facets of the same 355 junctions and must
agree with one another.

Panels not made here: schematics (Fig. 1a, 1f, 3a, 4b, 5a, 6p; illustration
software), LocusCompare plots (Fig. 1c, 2a; LocusCompareR on the colocalization
summary statistics, not part of this repository),
genome-browser tracks (Fig. 1e, 2c, 2f, 4i, 4k, 6a, 6f, 6k; Extended Data Fig. 1b,
2d, 2f, 2h, 4b, 4d, 6a, 6c, 6e, 6g; `05_peptide_evidence_and_browser_panels.Rmd`),
AlphaFold3 models (ChimeraX), gel images, interaction networks (Fig. 5e, 5g, 5h;
Extended Data Fig. 7; Cytoscape from the script 07/08 exports) and microscopy images.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Fig. 1b, 1d, 1g; Fig. 2b, 2d, 2e, 2g (bottom), 2h, 2i, 2j, 2k; Fig. 3b–f;
  Fig. 4a, 4c–h (and the counts for the 4b schematic); Fig. 5b–d, 5f;
  Fig. 6b, 6c, 6g, 6h, 6l, 6m, 6r, 6s, 6t.
- Extended Data Fig. 1a, 1c, 1d, 1e, 1f; 2a–c, 2e, 2g, 2i (bottom); 3a–h; 4a;
  5a–d; 7a; 8d, 8e, 8g.
- Supplementary Tables 8, 10–20 (S15 is copied from script 03 so the complete set is
  assembled in one place).
- Numbers quoted in Results for the long-read catalog (Fig. 3) and for the junction
  → isoform mapping (Fig. 4).

## Inputs

- Script 01: `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` (integrated CAD sQTL junction table),
  `OUT_VARIANT_VEP_SPLICEAI` (variant-level VEP/SpliceAI annotation).
- Script 02: `OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP`, `OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING`.
- Script 03: `OUT_AGGREGATE_JUNCTION`, `OUT_NMD_CAD_MAJORITY`,
  `OUT_NMD_NONCAD_MAJORITY`, `OUT_PROPERTY_STATS_MASTER`.
- Script 04: `OUT_PROTEIN_EFFECTS`, `OUT_AS_DISTRIBUTION`, `OUT_AS_CONSENSUS`.
- Script 05: `OUT_JUNCTION_VALIDATION`, `OUT_JUNCTION_EXCLUSIVE_PEPS`,
  `OUT_JUNCTION_NOT_USABLE`, `OUT_PEPTIDE_EVIDENCE_DETAIL`,
  `OUT_INTERESTING_ISOFORMS`, `OUT_PEPTIDE_SUPP_TABLE`.
- Script 06: `OUT_PAIR_GROUPINGS`, `OUT_PAIR_DOMINANT_MODE`,
  `OUT_PAIR_SIGNATURES_LONG`, `OUT_PROPERTY_AXIS_ORDER`, `OUT_PAIR_SIMILARITY`,
  `OUT_APMS_PAIR_SIGNATURES`, `OUT_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS`.
- Script 07: `OUT_MASTER_NETWORK_ANNOT`, `OUT_PREY_VSMC_SUPPORT`.
- Script 08: the per-bait `<BAIT>_pathway_details.csv` files in `D_GO_PAIR_TABLES`.
- Colocalization and sQTL source data: `F_COLOC_NOVEL_ONLY`, `F_SQTL_PSI_LONG`,
  `F_SQTL_SNP_JUNCTION`, `F_RAB5C_MST1_PSI`.
- Long-read catalog: `F_SQANTI3_CLASS`, `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_TSV`, `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM`,
  `F_MAPPED_FL_COUNTS`, `F_DEMUX_SAMPLE_COUNTS`, `F_BEST_ORF_CPM`; reference
  `F_GENCODE_V38_GTF`.
- AP-MS: `F_SRP54_SPECTRAL`, `F_SAINT_SET`, `F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS`, `F_APMS_BAIT_FASTA`.
- Experimental source data: `F_GEL_DENSITOMETRY`, `F_PARP12_OE_DATA`,
  `F_PARP12_DESEQ2`, `F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_IMAGING`, `F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_MECH`.

## Outputs

- `FIG_DIR/<panel>.svg` and `.png` for every panel listed above.
- `TABLE_DIR/*.csv` — the plotted values behind each panel (source data).
- `SUPP_DIR/TableS<nn>_*.csv` (and `TableS10_SQANTI_classifications.xlsx`) plus
  `TABLE_MANIFEST.csv`.

## Run order

Scripts 01–09 must have been run; this script reads only their exports.

# 0. Setup

## 0.1 Libraries, local constants and helpers

The palette, `theme_cell()`, `save_fig()`, `save_grid()`, `sz()`, `display_gene()` and
`sig_label()` come from `config.R`. Helpers that exist only for this script (a
legend-on-top theme variant, a markdown *P*-value formatter and the dplyr namespace
guard needed after GenomicRanges is attached) are defined here.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(svglite)
library(ggtext)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)
library(eulerr)
library(writexl)
ensure_dir(FIG_DIR, TABLE_DIR, SUPP_DIR)

# Lighter risk/nonrisk fills are used for bars and heatmaps in the figure panels.
COL_PANEL <- list(risk = COL_FIG$risk, nonrisk = COL_FIG$nonrisk, cad = COL$cad,
                  noncad = COL$noncad, novel = COL$novel, annotated = COL$annotated,
                  replicated = COL$annotated, neutral = COL$light)
GREEN <- c(darkest = "#3F5A4B", dark = "#557060", base = "#6E8B7B", mid = "#96AC9E", light = "#C2D0C7")
GREY  <- c(dark = "#7A7A7A", mid = "#A8A8A8", light = "#D4D4D4")
TEAL  <- GREEN[["base"]]
DOSAGE_COL <- c("Risk/Risk" = "#E87EA1", "Het" = "#8E6FBF", "Nonrisk/Nonrisk" = "#7FC4E8")
SPEC_LV  <- c("risk-specific", "shared", "nonrisk-specific")
SPEC_LAB <- c("Risk-specific", "Shared", "Nonrisk-specific")
SPEC_COL <- c("risk-specific" = COL_PANEL$risk, "shared" = GREY[["mid"]], "nonrisk-specific" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk)
cat_novel <- c("novel_in_catalog", "novel_not_in_catalog")
cat_known <- c("full-splice_match", "incomplete-splice_match")

# Variant of theme_cell() for the stacked bars of Extended Data Fig. 5a/b (legend on top).
s5_theme <- function(base = BASE_SIZE) {
  theme_cell(base) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.key.size = unit(3.2, "mm"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = base - 0.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size = base - 0.5),
          plot.title    = element_text(size = base + 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = base - 0.5, colour = "grey25"),
          plot.margin   = margin(6, 6, 4, 4))
}

# Significance stars: star() leaves NA blank, star_p() reports NA as "ns".
star   <- function(p) sig_label(p)
star_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "ns", sig_label(p))
wilcox_p <- function(x, g) tryCatch(wilcox.test(x ~ g)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
fisher_p <- function(b, g) tryCatch(fisher.test(table(g, b))$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
fmt_p_md <- function(p) {                 # HTML P-value formatter for ggtext subtitles
  if (is.na(p))    return("<i>P</i> = NA")
  if (p < 2.2e-16) return("<i>P</i> < 2.2 × 10<sup>−16</sup>")
  if (p >= 1e-3)   return(sprintf("<i>P</i> = %s", formatC(p, format = "g", digits = 2)))
  e <- floor(log10(p)); m <- p / 10^e
  sprintf("<i>P</i> = %.1f × 10<sup>%s</sup>", m, sub("-", "−", e))
}

# GenomicRanges/IRanges/S4Vectors (attached for Fig. 4a) mask several dplyr verbs;
# bind_dplyr() is called after they are attached so that later chunks see dplyr.
bind_dplyr <- function() {
  for (f in c("filter", "select", "slice", "count", "rename", "mutate", "arrange", "summarise",
              "distinct", "first", "desc", "slice_max", "slice_min", "recode"))
    assign(f, getExportedValue("dplyr", f), envir = globalenv())
  assign("reduce", purrr::reduce, envir = globalenv())
  invisible(NULL)
}
bind_dplyr()
```

## 0.2 Shared inputs

Objects used by more than one figure are loaded once so that the script knits from a
fresh session. Large inputs used by a single figure (the SQANTI3 catalog, the GTF, the
AP-MS network) are read in the section that uses them.

```{r inputs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_INTERESTING_ISOFORMS, F_SQANTI3_CLASS, F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_TSV, OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED,
              OUT_PAIR_GROUPINGS, OUT_PAIR_DOMINANT_MODE, OUT_PEPTIDE_EVIDENCE_DETAIL)

cand   <- read_csv(OUT_INTERESTING_ISOFORMS,    show_col_types = FALSE)  # peptide-supported isoforms with notable features
detail <- read_csv(OUT_PEPTIDE_EVIDENCE_DETAIL, show_col_types = FALSE)  # per-peptide risk/nonrisk/shared classification
prot   <- read_tsv(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_TSV,        show_col_types = FALSE)  # SQANTI Protein classification
lfc_m  <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED,          show_col_types = FALSE)  # integrated CAD sQTL table (355 junctions)

# Risk/nonrisk isoform pairs: 94 sQTL-derived pairs plus the manual AP-MS pairs.
pairs <- read_csv(OUT_PAIR_GROUPINGS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^﻿", "", .x)) %>%
  mutate(risk_pb    = str_extract(risk_pb,    "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         nonrisk_pb = str_extract(nonrisk_pb, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"))
pair_modes <- read_csv(OUT_PAIR_DOMINANT_MODE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^﻿", "", .x)) %>%
  filter(pair_type != "manual_apms")
stopifnot("expected 94 sQTL-derived pairs" = nrow(pair_modes) == 94)
```

## 0.3 Junction master table (n = 355)

One row per distinct CAD sQTL junction, combining annotation status (script 01),
long-read capture and coding class (script 02), the dominant predicted protein effect
(script 04) and peptide evidence (script 05). Every Fig. 4 panel reads from this
object, and it is exported as the basis of Supplementary Table 13.

```{r junction_master, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP, OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING, OUT_JUNCTION_VALIDATION,
              OUT_JUNCTION_EXCLUSIVE_PEPS, OUT_JUNCTION_NOT_USABLE, OUT_PROTEIN_EFFECTS)

gj_keys   <- lfc_m %>%
  filter(str_detect(effect_direction, regex("increas|decreas", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  pull(junction_key) %>% unique()
lr_keys   <- unique(read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP, show_col_types = FALSE)$junction_key)
cds_class <- read_csv(OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING,    show_col_types = FALSE)
jv        <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_VALIDATION,    show_col_types = FALSE)
excl      <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_EXCLUSIVE_PEPS, show_col_types = FALSE)
not_usable <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_NOT_USABLE,   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(junction_key, not_usable_reason)
# "Probeable" junctions fall within the CDS of at least one long-read isoform.
cds_keys  <- cds_class$junction_key[cds_class$coding_class == "CDS (at least partial)"]

# One dominant predicted protein effect per junction. A junction that belongs to more
# than one cluster can carry more than one call; the priority order below resolves it.
# NMD is a consequence of the resulting transcript rather than a splice class, so it is
# reported separately (Extended Data Fig. 5b, Table S13) and is not in this list.
EFFECT_PRIORITY <- c("ES / inclusion in ORF", "Alt splice site in ORF", "AFE/ALE in ORF",
                     "Complex / other", "Non-coding splice event")
pj_full <- read_csv(OUT_PROTEIN_EFFECTS, show_col_types = FALSE)
rk_of   <- function(x) { m <- match(tolower(x), tolower(EFFECT_PRIORITY))
                         ifelse(is.na(m), length(EFFECT_PRIORITY) + 1L, m) }
dom <- pj_full %>%
  transmute(jid = cad_sqtl_junction, effect = trimws(as.character(protein_effect))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(effect), effect != "") %>%
  mutate(rk = rk_of(effect)) %>%
  arrange(jid, rk) %>% group_by(jid) %>% filter(row_number() == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(junction_key = jid, protein_effect = effect)
write_excel_csv(dom, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "protein_effect_per_junction.csv"))

junction_master <- lfc_m %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_name        = paste(sort(unique(gene_name)), collapse = ";"),
    clusters         = paste(sort(unique(cluster)), collapse = ";"),
    n_clusters       = dplyr::n_distinct(cluster),
    lead_snps        = paste(sort(unique(SNP_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    conditions       = paste(sort(unique(Condition)), collapse = ";"),
    effect_direction = paste(sort(unique(effect_direction)), collapse = ";"),
    in_lr            = any(!is.na(smc_isoforms)         & smc_isoforms != ""),
    in_gencode       = any(!is.na(gencode_v38_isoforms) & gencode_v38_isoforms != ""),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    lr_captured = junction_key %in% lr_keys,
    probeable   = junction_key %in% cds_keys,
    annotation_status = case_when(
      in_lr &  in_gencode ~ "GENCODE v38 + long-read",
      !in_lr & in_gencode ~ "GENCODE v38 only",
      in_lr & !in_gencode ~ "Long-read only",
      TRUE                ~ "Neither")) %>%
  left_join(cds_class %>% distinct(junction_key, coding_class), by = "junction_key") %>%
  left_join(dom, by = "junction_key") %>%
  left_join(jv %>% select(junction_key, n_risk, n_nonrisk, n_shared, validated, side),
            by = "junction_key") %>%
  left_join(excl %>% select(junction_key,
                            n_risk_peptides_possible    = n_R_possible,
                            n_nonrisk_peptides_possible = n_N_possible,
                            risk_peptide_status         = risk_status,
                            nonrisk_peptide_status      = nonrisk_status),
            by = "junction_key") %>%
  left_join(not_usable, by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(usable    = junction_key %in% jv$junction_key,
         validated = replace_na(validated, FALSE),
         side      = replace_na(side, "not evaluable"),
         across(c(n_risk, n_nonrisk, n_shared), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
         not_usable_reason = case_when(
           usable                     ~ NA_character_,
           !is.na(not_usable_reason)  ~ not_usable_reason,
           !junction_key %in% gj_keys ~ "no direction call",
           TRUE                       ~ "not evaluated")) %>%
  relocate(junction_key, gene_name, n_clusters, effect_direction,
           annotation_status, coding_class, lr_captured, probeable,
           usable, validated, side, not_usable_reason, protein_effect)

# The counts the manuscript relies on: 355 junctions, 146 captured in long-read
# transcripts, 133 within a CDS (probeable).
stopifnot(
  "not 355 distinct junctions" = nrow(junction_master) == 355,
  "probeable count changed"    = sum(junction_master$probeable)   == 133,
  "LR-captured count changed"  = sum(junction_master$lr_captured) == 146)
cat(sprintf("junctions %d | LR-captured %d | probeable %d | usable %d | validated %d\n",
            nrow(junction_master), sum(junction_master$lr_captured),
            sum(junction_master$probeable), sum(junction_master$usable),
            sum(junction_master$validated)))
write_excel_csv(junction_master, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "SuppTable_junction_master.csv"))
```


# Figure 1 — CAD GWAS colocalization

## 1b — colocalization PPH4 along the genome

The unit is the colocalized junction; x is chromosomal order (not to scale) and y is
PPH4. A junction colocalized in both VSMC phenotypes is drawn as a barbell linking the
quiescent (square) and proliferative (triangle) points. Orange marks colocalizations
not reported previously; sGenes with PPH4 > 0.9 are labelled, one label per gene.

```{r fig1b_coloc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
PANEL_W <- 7.5; PANEL_H <- 2.8
LABEL_PPH4_MIN     <- 0.9
LABEL_ONE_PER_GENE <- TRUE
Y_FLOOR            <- 0.70

require_files(F_COLOC_NOVEL_ONLY)
coloc <- read_csv(F_COLOC_NOVEL_ONLY, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(PPH4 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(PPH4)),
         Condition = case_when(
           grepl("quiesc", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Quiescent",
           grepl("prolif", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Proliferative",
           TRUE ~ str_to_title(str_trim(Condition))),
         junction = str_extract(cluster_id, "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+"))

nov_col <- names(coloc)[grepl("novel|replicat|status", names(coloc), ignore.case = TRUE)]
coloc$novelty <- if (length(nov_col))
  ifelse(grepl("replicat", coloc[[nov_col[1]]], ignore.case = TRUE), "Replicated", "Novel") else "Novel"

jx <- coloc %>% group_by(sGene, junction, Condition, novelty) %>%
  summarise(PPH4 = max(PPH4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

chr_to_num <- function(c) {
  c <- str_remove(toupper(str_trim(c)), "^CHR")
  dplyr::case_when(c == "X" ~ 23, c == "Y" ~ 24, c %in% c("M", "MT") ~ 25,
                   grepl("^[0-9]+$", c) ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(c)), TRUE ~ 99)
}
jx_pos <- jx %>% distinct(junction) %>%
  mutate(chr_raw = str_extract(junction, "^[^:]+"),
         start   = as.numeric(str_extract(junction, "(?<=:)[0-9]+")),
         chr_num = chr_to_num(chr_raw)) %>%
  arrange(chr_num, start) %>% mutate(xpos = row_number())
jx <- jx %>% left_join(jx_pos %>% select(junction, chr_raw, chr_num, xpos), by = "junction")

chr_breaks <- jx_pos %>% group_by(chr_raw, chr_num) %>%
  summarise(mid = mean(xpos), min_x = min(xpos), max_x = max(xpos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(chr_num) %>% mutate(band = chr_num %% 2)

wide <- jx %>% select(junction, xpos, Condition, PPH4) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = PPH4)
seg <- if (all(c("Quiescent", "Proliferative") %in% names(wide)))
  wide %>% filter(!is.na(Quiescent), !is.na(Proliferative)) else tibble()

jx_label <- jx %>% group_by(sGene, junction, xpos) %>% summarise(y = max(PPH4), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(y > LABEL_PPH4_MIN)
if (LABEL_ONE_PER_GENE)
  jx_label <- jx_label %>% group_by(sGene) %>% slice_max(y, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
jx_label <- jx_label %>% mutate(sGene = gsub(",\\s*", ", ", sGene))

cat(sprintf("Fig 1b: junctions %d | barbells %d | chromosomes %d | labels %d\n",
            n_distinct(jx$junction), nrow(seg), n_distinct(jx$chr_raw), nrow(jx_label)))

shape_map <- c(Quiescent = 22, Proliferative = 24)
fill_map  <- c(Novel = COL_PANEL$novel, Replicated = COL_PANEL$replicated)

p_fig1b <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = filter(chr_breaks, band == 1),
            aes(xmin = min_x - 0.5, xmax = max_x + 0.5, ymin = Y_FLOOR, ymax = 1),
            fill = "white", inherit.aes = FALSE)
if (nrow(seg))
  p_fig1b <- p_fig1b +
    geom_segment(data = seg, aes(x = xpos, xend = xpos, y = Quiescent, yend = Proliferative),
                 colour = "#BCBCBC", linewidth = 0.35)
p_fig1b <- p_fig1b +
  geom_point(data = jx, aes(x = xpos, y = PPH4, shape = Condition, fill = novelty),
             size = 1.8, colour = "white", stroke = 0.25) +
  geom_text_repel(data = jx_label, aes(x = xpos, y = y, label = sGene),
                  size = sz(7), segment.size = 0.15, segment.colour = "grey55",
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.25, point.padding = 0.1,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, colour = "grey20", fontface = "italic", seed = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_map, name = "Phenotype") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, name = "CAD sQTL Colocalization") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chr_breaks$mid, labels = chr_breaks$chr_raw, expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(Y_FLOOR, 1, 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(Y_FLOOR, 1.0)) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome (not to scale)", y = "Colocalization posterior (PPH4)") +
  guides(fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 2.4)),
         shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey40"))) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 8))

save_fig(p_fig1b, "Fig1b_coloc_barbell", w = min(MAX_W, PANEL_W), h = PANEL_H)
p_fig1b
```

## 1d, 2b, 2d, 2e and Extended Data 1a, 1c, 1e, 2a–c — sQTL PSI-by-genotype boxplots

One panel per (gene, SNP, PSI measure) for the sQTLs cited in the manuscript, exported
at 2.6 in and at 1.7 × 2.2 in (`_smaller`, the size used in the assembled figures).
Genotypes are ordered by CAD risk-allele dosage, so the risk allele must be known for
each plotted SNP; the alleles below are the CAD risk alleles of the GWAS lead variant
(or of the LD proxy that was genotyped) and are the alleles stated in the legends.

```{r sqtl_psi_panels, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_SQTL_PSI_LONG, F_SQTL_SNP_JUNCTION)
sq          <- read_csv(F_SQTL_PSI_LONG,     show_col_types = FALSE)
sqtl_lookup <- read_csv(F_SQTL_SNP_JUNCTION, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Panels cited in the manuscript (gene, plotted SNP) and the file-name prefix of the
# figure panel each one feeds. PARP12 contributes two panels (exon-10 inclusion and
# skipping junctions), one per PSI measure.
CITED_PSI_PANELS <- tribble(
  ~gene,      ~rsid,         ~panel,
  "R3HCC1L",  "rs10736122",  "Fig1d",
  "ADAMTS7",  "rs71448830",  "Fig2b",
  "PARP12",   "rs2286196",   "Fig2de",
  "TRIM65",   "rs4398150",   "ED1a",
  "LIPA",     "rs1332328",   "ED1c",
  "NME7",     "rs1140523",   "ED1e",
  "WIPI1",    "rs883541",    "ED2a",
  "DCLRE1B",  "rs3761936",   "ED2b",
  "ITGA1",    "rs4074793",   "ED2c")

# NME7 and TRIM65 were plotted at an LD proxy of the lead sQTL variant and therefore
# have no junction_key in the lookup; the colocalized junction (proliferative
# condition, Supplementary Table 2) is supplied here for the subtitle.
sqtl_lookup <- sqtl_lookup %>%
  mutate(junction_key = case_when(
    sqtl_snp_plotted == "rs1140523" & is.na(junction_key) ~ "chr1:169324500:169367708",
    sqtl_snp_plotted == "rs4398150" & is.na(junction_key) ~ "chr17:75891347:75892267",
    TRUE ~ junction_key))
stopifnot("junction_key missing in the sQTL lookup" = !any(is.na(sqtl_lookup$junction_key)))

# CAD risk allele per plotted SNP (the allele named in each figure legend).
risk_allele_map <- c(
  rs2286196 = "G", rs4074793 = "G", rs883541 = "A", rs71448830 = "A", rs1332328 = "T",
  rs10736122 = "G", rs3761936 = "C", rs4398150 = "T", rs1140523 = "G")

sq <- sq %>%
  semi_join(CITED_PSI_PANELS, by = c("gene", "rsid")) %>%
  mutate(
    # one R3HCC1L measure is labelled with its cluster identifier in the source table
    psi_measure = ifelse(str_detect(psi_measure, "^clu_"), "PSI", psi_measure),
    risk_allele = risk_allele_map[rsid],
    n_risk = str_count(genotype, fixed(coalesce(risk_allele, ""))),
    dosage = factor(case_when(n_risk == 2 ~ "Risk/Risk", n_risk == 1 ~ "Het", TRUE ~ "Nonrisk/Nonrisk"),
                    levels = c("Risk/Risk", "Het", "Nonrisk/Nonrisk")))
stopifnot("risk allele missing for a plotted SNP" = !any(is.na(sq$risk_allele)))

sqtl_panel <- function(d, gene, rsid, measure, name, w = 2.6, h = 2.6) {
  d <- d %>% filter(gene == !!gene, rsid == !!rsid, psi_measure == !!measure, !is.na(psi))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { message("no data: ", gene, " ", rsid, " ", measure); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  ra <- unique(d$risk_allele)
  gt_order <- d %>% distinct(genotype) %>%
    mutate(rk = str_count(genotype, fixed(ra))) %>% arrange(desc(rk)) %>% pull(genotype)
  d <- d %>% mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = gt_order))
  ncount <- d %>% count(genotype)
  xlabs <- setNames(sprintf("%s\n(n=%d)", ncount$genotype, ncount$n), ncount$genotype)

  lk <- sqtl_lookup %>% filter(sqtl_snp_plotted == rsid, psi_measure == measure) %>% slice(1)
  loc <- if (nrow(lk) == 0) "" else if (is.na(lk$junction_key)) lk$cluster
         else sprintf("%s · %s", lk$cluster, lk$junction_key)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(genotype, psi, fill = dosage)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = dosage), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey25") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = DOSAGE_COL, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DOSAGE_COL, guide = "none", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = xlabs) +
    labs(x = sprintf("%s  (risk: %s)", rsid, ra), y = "Percent Spliced In (scaled)",
         title = sprintf("*%s* sQTL", gene), subtitle = loc) +
    theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
          legend.margin = margin(t = -4), aspect.ratio = 1,
          plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 1.5, colour = "grey30"))
  save_fig(p, name, w = w, h = h); print(p); p
}

panels <- sq %>% distinct(gene, rsid, psi_measure) %>%
  inner_join(CITED_PSI_PANELS, by = c("gene", "rsid"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(panels))) {
  g <- panels$gene[i]; rs <- panels$rsid[i]; m <- panels$psi_measure[i]
  multi_measure <- with(panels, sum(gene == g & rsid == rs) > 1)
  tag <- paste0(panels$panel[i], "_sqtl_", g,
                if (multi_measure) paste0("_", str_replace_all(str_trunc(m, 10, ellipsis = ""), "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "")) else "")
  sqtl_panel(sq, g, rs, m, tag,                     w = 2.6, h = 2.6)
  sqtl_panel(sq, g, rs, m, paste0(tag, "_smaller"), w = 1.7, h = 2.2)
}
```

## 1g — SpliceAI / VEP evidence for the 1,534 LD-expanded variants

The variant-level table from script 01 holds one row per variant with any splicing
evidence (SpliceAI delta or a VEP splice consequence). The bar partitions those
variants by maximum SpliceAI delta tier; the denominator in the axis label is the
number of variants submitted (the end point of the Fig. 1f prioritization).

```{r fig1g_spliceai, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_VARIANT_VEP_SPLICEAI)
per_variant <- read_csv(OUT_VARIANT_VEP_SPLICEAI, show_col_types = FALSE)
n_submitted <- 1534L   # variants submitted to VEP + SpliceAI (Fig. 1f end point; Supplementary Table 4)
stopifnot(all(c("rsID", "max_delta", "consequences") %in% names(per_variant)))

tier_levels <- c("High (≥0.5)", "Moderate (0.2-0.5)", "Weak (0.05-0.2)",
                 "Minimal (<0.05)", "No SpliceAI score (VEP only)")
tier_pal <- c("High (≥0.5)"             = "#4C1C58",
              "Moderate (0.2-0.5)"           = "#7B2D8E",
              "Weak (0.05-0.2)"              = "#C29DCB",
              "Minimal (<0.05)"              = "#E8DCEC",
              "No SpliceAI score (VEP only)" = "#969696")
tier_txt <- c("High (≥0.5)" = "white", "Moderate (0.2-0.5)" = "white",
              "Weak (0.05-0.2)" = "grey20", "Minimal (<0.05)" = "grey20",
              "No SpliceAI score (VEP only)" = "white")
assign_tier <- function(d) factor(dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(d) | d == 0 ~ "No SpliceAI score (VEP only)",
    d >= 0.5 ~ "High (≥0.5)", d >= 0.2 ~ "Moderate (0.2-0.5)",
    d >= 0.05 ~ "Weak (0.05-0.2)", TRUE ~ "Minimal (<0.05)"), levels = tier_levels)

sa_sum <- per_variant %>%
  mutate(tier_s = assign_tier(max_delta)) %>%
  count(tier_s, name = "n_variants") %>%
  complete(tier_s, fill = list(n_variants = 0)) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_variants / sum(n_variants))
n_shown <- sum(sa_sum$n_variants)
cat(sprintf("Fig 1g: %d variants with splicing evidence (of %d tested)\n", n_shown, n_submitted))
write_csv(sa_sum, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig1g_spliceai_tiers.csv"))

INLINE_MIN_FRAC <- 0.15   # segments below this fraction are called out above the bar
sa_pos <- sa_sum %>%
  arrange(tier_s) %>%
  mutate(x2 = cumsum(n_variants), x1 = x2 - n_variants, xmid = (x1 + x2) / 2,
         frac = n_variants / sum(n_variants),
         lab_short = dplyr::recode(as.character(tier_s),
                       "High (≥0.5)" = "High", "Moderate (0.2-0.5)" = "Mod.",
                       "Weak (0.05-0.2)" = "Weak", "Minimal (<0.05)" = "Minimal",
                       "No SpliceAI score (VEP only)" = "VEP only"))
inline_lab  <- sa_pos %>% filter(frac >= INLINE_MIN_FRAC, n_variants > 0)
callout_lab <- sa_pos %>% filter(frac <  INLINE_MIN_FRAC, n_variants > 0)

p_sa_tiers <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = sa_pos, aes(xmin = x1, xmax = x2, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = tier_s),
            colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = inline_lab, aes(x = xmid, y = 0.5, label = n_variants,
                                   colour = tier_txt[as.character(tier_s)]), size = sz(7)) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = callout_lab,
            aes(x = xmid, y = 1, label = paste0(lab_short, ": ", n_variants)),
            nudge_y = 1.05, direction = "x", size = sz(7), colour = "grey20",
            segment.size = 0.25, segment.colour = "grey55", min.segment.length = 0,
            box.padding = 0.15, seed = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tier_pal, name = NULL, drop = FALSE, breaks = tier_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2.4), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = sprintf("CAD-colocalized sQTL variants with splicing evidence (n = %d of %s)",
                   n_shown, format(n_submitted, big.mark = ",")), y = NULL) +
  theme_cell(7) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.26, "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

save_fig(p_sa_tiers, "Fig1g_spliceai_tiers", w = 3.6, h = 2.0)
p_sa_tiers
```


# Extended Data Figure 1 — sQTL effects for prioritized variants

## 1d, 1f — RAB5C and MST1 (genotyped SNPs in LD with the lead variant)

The plotted SNPs (rs2240010, rs13085791) are LD proxies of the colocalizing lead
variants, so the CAD risk allele of each proxy was established from its phase with the
lead variant (D′ ≈ 1) and the direction of the sQTL effect; the resulting alleles are
set explicitly below and are the alleles stated in the legends. Only the junction
shown in the manuscript is drawn for each gene.

```{r figED1df_rab5c_mst1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_RAB5C_MST1_PSI)
RISK_ALLELES <- c(RAB5C = "A", MST1 = "C")
CITED_JUNCTION <- c(RAB5C = "17:42137878:42154893", MST1 = "3:49684189:49684314")
ED1_PANEL      <- c(RAB5C = "ED1d", MST1 = "ED1f")
SQ2_LOC <- c(   # cluster and junction for the subtitle (proliferative condition)
  "17:42137878:42154893" = "clu_15826 · chr17:42137878:42154893",
  "3:49684189:49684314"  = "clu_29362 · chr3:49684189:49684314")

read_sqtl_sheet <- function(sheet, gene) {
  raw <- read_excel(F_RAB5C_MST1_PSI, sheet = sheet)
  geno_col  <- names(raw)[2]
  rsid      <- str_extract(geno_col, "rs[0-9]+")
  junc_cols <- names(raw)[3:ncol(raw)]
  raw %>%
    rename(donor = 1, genotype = 2) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(junc_cols), names_to = "junction_full", values_to = "psi") %>%
    mutate(psi = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(psi))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(psi)) %>%
    mutate(gene = gene, rsid = rsid, junction = str_replace(junction_full, ":clu.*$", ""))
}
sq2 <- bind_rows(read_sqtl_sheet("RAB5C", "RAB5C"), read_sqtl_sheet("MST1", "MST1")) %>%
  mutate(risk_allele = RISK_ALLELES[gene]) %>%
  filter(junction == CITED_JUNCTION[gene])
stopifnot("cited RAB5C/MST1 junctions not found in the workbook" = n_distinct(sq2$gene) == 2)

sqtl_panel2 <- function(d, gene, junction, name) {
  d <- d %>% filter(gene == !!gene, junction == !!junction, !is.na(psi))
  rsid <- unique(d$rsid); ra <- unique(d$risk_allele)
  gt_order <- d %>% distinct(genotype) %>%
    mutate(rk = str_count(genotype, fixed(ra))) %>% arrange(desc(rk)) %>% pull(genotype)
  d <- d %>% mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = gt_order),
                    n_risk = str_count(as.character(genotype), fixed(ra)),
                    dosage = factor(case_when(n_risk == 2 ~ "Risk/Risk", n_risk == 1 ~ "Het",
                                              TRUE ~ "Nonrisk/Nonrisk"),
                                    levels = c("Risk/Risk", "Het", "Nonrisk/Nonrisk")))
  ncount <- d %>% count(genotype)
  xlabs  <- setNames(sprintf("%s\n(n=%d)", ncount$genotype, ncount$n), ncount$genotype)
  sub_txt <- if (junction %in% names(SQ2_LOC)) SQ2_LOC[[junction]] else paste0("chr", junction)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(genotype, psi)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = dosage), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = dosage), width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey25") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = DOSAGE_COL, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DOSAGE_COL, guide = "none", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = xlabs) +
    labs(x = sprintf("%s  (risk: %s)", rsid, ra), y = "Percent Spliced In (scaled)",
         title = sprintf("*%s* sQTL", gene), subtitle = sub_txt) +
    theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 1.5, colour = "grey30"),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(t = -4))
  save_fig(p, name, w = 2, h = 2.6); print(p); invisible(p)
}
for (g in names(CITED_JUNCTION))
  sqtl_panel2(sq2, g, CITED_JUNCTION[[g]], sprintf("%s_sqtl_%s", ED1_PANEL[[g]], g))
```

## 2g (bottom) and Extended Data 2e, 2g — gel densitometry as a fraction of lane signal

Each band is expressed as `band / sum(all bands in that lane)`, so the y-axis reports
isoform composition per genotype rather than absolute intensity, which differs between
lanes. ITGA1 (Extended Data Fig. 2i) is plotted from raw replicate values instead
because only the risk-associated product was quantified.

```{r fig2g_gel_fraction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_GEL_DENSITOMETRY)
RISK_ISOFORM  <- c(DCLRE1B = "Canonical", PARP12 = "Canonical", WIPI1 = "Alternative")
GEL_CONDITION <- c(PARP12 = "Proliferative", WIPI1 = "Proliferative", DCLRE1B = "Proliferative")
GEL_PANEL     <- c(PARP12 = "Fig2g", WIPI1 = "ED2e", DCLRE1B = "ED2g")
risk_cols <- c(Risk = COL_PANEL$risk, Nonrisk = COL_PANEL$nonrisk)

gel_fraction <- function(sheet) {
  cond <- GEL_CONDITION[[sheet]]
  read_excel(F_GEL_DENSITOMETRY, sheet = sheet) %>%
    rename(value = `Average (n=2)`) %>%
    filter(Condition == cond, !is.na(value)) %>%
    mutate(Genotype = factor(Genotype),
           risk_class = factor(if_else(Isoform == RISK_ISOFORM[[sheet]], "Risk", "Nonrisk"),
                               levels = c("Nonrisk", "Risk"))) %>%
    group_by(Genotype) %>%                       # lane = one genotype in this condition
    mutate(lane_total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), fraction = value / lane_total) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(gene = sheet, Condition = cond)
}
gel_all <- purrr::map_dfr(names(GEL_PANEL), gel_fraction)
chk <- gel_all %>% group_by(gene, Genotype) %>% summarise(s = sum(fraction), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("lane fractions do not sum to 1" = all(abs(chk$s - 1) < 1e-8))
write_csv(gel_all %>% select(gene, Condition, Genotype, Isoform, risk_class, value, lane_total, fraction),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "gel_quant_lane_fractions.csv"))

for (g in names(GEL_PANEL)) {
  d <- gel_all %>% filter(gene == g)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Genotype, fraction, fill = risk_class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = risk_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of total\nband intensity", title = sprintf("*%s* amplicon ratios", g)) +
    theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"), plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown())
  save_fig(p, sprintf("%s_gel_fraction_%s", GEL_PANEL[[g]], g), 3.2, 0.79); print(p)
}
```

```{r figED2i_itga1_gel, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
d <- read_excel(F_GEL_DENSITOMETRY, sheet = "ITGA1_raw") %>%
```

## 2j — NF-κB target and inflammatory genes

Normalized expression per sample comes from the source-data workbook; the significance
stars are the Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted *P* values of the DESeq2 comparison of risk
versus nonrisk isoform overexpression (`F_PARP12_DESEQ2`), read from the deposited
results table rather than re-run here.

```{r fig2j_gene_grid, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_PARP12_DESEQ2)
gde_cols   <- c("Risk" = COL_PANEL$risk, "Nonrisk" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk)
GENE_ORDER <- c("IL1A", "TNIP3", "BIRC3", "PTGS2", "SAMD9", "SAMD9L", "ESM1", "BHLHE40")
GENE_LABS  <- sprintf("*%s*", GENE_ORDER)

gde <- read_excel(F_PARP12_OE_DATA, sheet = "Gene Diff Exp") %>%
  rename(sample = 1) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(str_detect(sample, "_CAN$"), "Risk", "Nonrisk")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, group), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
  mutate(gene     = factor(str_trim(gene), levels = GENE_ORDER),
         gene_lab = factor(sprintf("*%s*", as.character(gene)), levels = GENE_LABS),
         group    = factor(group, levels = c("Risk", "Nonrisk")))

# DESeq2 results (risk vs nonrisk OE): expected columns gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj.
deseq <- read_csv(F_PARP12_DESEQ2, show_col_types = FALSE)
need_cols <- c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj")
if (!all(need_cols %in% names(deseq)))
  stop("F_PARP12_DESEQ2 must contain the columns ", paste(need_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "; found: ", paste(names(deseq), collapse = ", "))
deseq_padj <- deseq %>% filter(gene %in% GENE_ORDER) %>% select(gene, padj)
stopifnot("DESeq2 padj missing for a plotted gene" = all(GENE_ORDER %in% deseq_padj$gene))
# star thresholds as stated in the Fig. 2j legend (BH-adjusted)
stars <- deseq_padj %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = GENE_ORDER),
         lab  = case_when(padj < 0.001 ~ "***", padj < 0.05 ~ "**", padj < 0.1 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"))
ann <- gde %>% group_by(gene, gene_lab) %>%
  summarise(y = max(expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08, .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(stars, by = "gene")
write_csv(gde %>% left_join(stars %>% select(gene, padj), by = "gene"),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig2j_PARP12_NFkB_target_genes.csv"))

p_grid <- ggplot(gde, aes(group, expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.4, stroke = 0, colour = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = sz(9)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_lab, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gde_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Normalized expression") +
  theme_cell() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 7),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.22, "cm"))
save_fig(p_grid, "Fig2j_PARP12_NFkB_target_genes", w = 6.2, h = 2)
p_grid
```

## 2k — NF-κB p65 (pS536) phospho-ELISA

The three conditions were measured on the same 12 lysate measurements (six donors in
duplicate), so each comparison is a one-tailed paired t-test with the directional
hypothesis that the overexpression condition listed second has higher phospho-p65
(Methods, "Statistics and reproducibility").

```{r fig2k_elisa, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nfkb_cols <- c("GFP" = COL_PANEL$neutral, "Risk" = COL_PANEL$risk, "Nonrisk" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk)
nfkb_wide <- read_excel(F_PARP12_OE_DATA, sheet = "NFkB ELISA") %>%
  rename(sample = `Sample ID`) %>%
  rename_with(~ dplyr::recode(.x, "Canonical OE" = "Risk", "Alternate OE" = "Nonrisk"))
stopifnot(all(c("GFP", "Risk", "Nonrisk") %in% names(nfkb_wide)),
          "expected 12 paired measurements per condition" = nrow(nfkb_wide) == 12)
nfkb <- nfkb_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "group", values_to = "p65") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("GFP", "Risk", "Nonrisk")))

paired_one_tailed <- function(lo, hi)
  t.test(nfkb_wide[[hi]], nfkb_wide[[lo]], paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")$p.value
nfkb_p <- tribble(
  ~g1,    ~g2,
  "GFP",  "Risk",
  "GFP",  "Nonrisk",
  "Nonrisk", "Risk") %>%
  mutate(p = map2_dbl(g1, g2, paired_one_tailed))
stopifnot("risk-vs-nonrisk ELISA P changed" =
            round(nfkb_p$p[nfkb_p$g1 == "Nonrisk" & nfkb_p$g2 == "Risk"], 3) == 0.029)
write_csv(nfkb_p, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig2k_PARP12_p65_ELISA_tests.csv"))

ymax <- max(nfkb$p65, na.rm = TRUE)
brackets <- nfkb_p %>%
  mutate(x1 = pmin(as.numeric(factor(g1, levels = levels(nfkb$group))),
                   as.numeric(factor(g2, levels = levels(nfkb$group)))),
         x2 = pmax(as.numeric(factor(g1, levels = levels(nfkb$group))),
                   as.numeric(factor(g2, levels = levels(nfkb$group)))),
         y  = ymax + c(2.0, 4.2, 0.6), tick = ymax * 0.03,
         lab = ifelse(p < 0.05, sprintf("*P* = %.3f *", p), sprintf("*P* = %.3f", p)))

p_nfkb <- ggplot(nfkb, aes(group, p65, fill = group)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", width = 0.65, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.8, stroke = 0, colour = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = brackets, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y + tick * 1.2, label = lab),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = sz(7), fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                        label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nfkb_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative NF-κB p65\n(pS536) levels", title = "NF-κB p65 ELISA") +
  theme_cell()
save_fig(p_nfkb, "Fig2k_PARP12_p65_ELISA", w = 1.5, h = 2)
p_nfkb
```


# Figure 3 and Extended Data Figure 3 — long-read VSMC transcriptome and predicted proteome

Full-length read counts come from the Iso-Seq3 collapse output (`F_MAPPED_FL_COUNTS`),
whose total matches the demultiplexing table exactly; transcript CPM is
`FL / total FL × 10^6`. The expressed catalog is the set of isoforms detected in at
least two of the six donors (`MIN_DONORS`), as stated in Methods.

## 3.0 Expressed transcript and protein catalogs

```{r fig3_setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_MAPPED_FL_COUNTS, F_DEMUX_SAMPLE_COUNTS)
nov_fill <- c(Annotated = COL_PANEL$annotated, Novel = COL_PANEL$novel)

# per-donor read totals (Extended Data Fig. 3a) and the CPM denominator
demux <- read_tsv(F_DEMUX_SAMPLE_COUNTS, show_col_types = FALSE)
donor_tbl <- demux %>%
  group_by(donor) %>%
  summarise(total_fl_count = sum(fl_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dn = as.numeric(factor(donor)),
         donor_label = factor(paste("Donor", dn), levels = paste("Donor", sort(unique(dn))))) %>%
  arrange(dn)
TOTAL_FL <- sum(donor_tbl$total_fl_count)

# mapped FL counts: per-isoform total and per-donor detection (samples S01/S02 = donor 1, ...)
mfl <- read_csv(F_MAPPED_FL_COUNTS, show_col_types = FALSE)
smp_cols <- setdiff(names(mfl), "id")
sc <- as.matrix(mfl[smp_cols]); sc[is.na(sc)] <- 0
don_idx <- ceiling(as.integer(str_extract(smp_cols, "(?<=^S)[0-9]+")) / 2)
det     <- sapply(sort(unique(don_idx)), function(d) rowSums(sc[, don_idx == d, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
mfl_slim <- tibble(isoform = mfl$id, FL = rowSums(sc), n_donors = rowSums(det))
stopifnot("mapped FL total does not match the demux total" = sum(mfl_slim$FL) == TOTAL_FL)
cat(sprintf("CPM denominator: %s full-length reads\n", comma(TOTAL_FL)))

# transcript catalog (the per-sample FL columns of the SQANTI3 table are incomplete and are replaced)
rna <- read_tsv(F_SQANTI3_CLASS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("FL", "total_FL")), -starts_with("FL.")) %>%
  left_join(mfl_slim, by = "isoform") %>%
  mutate(CPM_transcript_level = FL / TOTAL_FL * 1e6)

MIN_DONORS <- 2
rna_expr  <- rna %>% filter(n_donors >= MIN_DONORS)
prot_expr <- prot %>% filter(pb %in% rna_expr$isoform)
cat(sprintf("catalog: %s isoforms | expressed (>=%d donors): %s isoforms / %s genes | proteins: %s\n",
            comma(nrow(rna)), MIN_DONORS, comma(nrow(rna_expr)),
            comma(n_distinct(rna_expr$associated_gene)), comma(nrow(prot_expr))))
```

```{r fig3bc_categories, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

cat(sprintf("Fig 3c: %s of %s protein isoforms classified (%.1f%% novel)\n",

  theme_cell(7) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8))
save_fig(p_protcat, "Fig3c_protein_categories", 2.9, 2.3)
p_rnacat; p_protcat
```

## 3d — genes whose highest-expressed isoform is novel

```{r fig3d_dominant_novelty, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dom_gene <- rna_expr %>%
  filter(!is.na(associated_gene), FL > 0,
         structural_category %in% c(cat_known, cat_novel)) %>%
  group_by(associated_gene) %>%
  slice_max(FL, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(gene = associated_gene, top_isoform = isoform,
            cls = ifelse(structural_category %in% cat_novel, "Novel", "Annotated"))
hi <- dom_gene %>% count(cls, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n), cls = factor(cls, levels = c("Annotated", "Novel"))) %>%
  arrange(cls) %>%
  mutate(ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0), mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2)
cat(sprintf("Fig 3d: %s genes; highest-expressed isoform novel in %s (%.1f%%)\n",
            comma(sum(hi$n)), comma(hi$n[hi$cls == "Novel"]), 100 * hi$frac[hi$cls == "Novel"]))
write_csv(dom_gene, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig3d_dominant_isoform_per_gene.csv"))

p_3d <- ggplot(hi) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 3, xmax = 4, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = cls), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.5, y = mid, label = sprintf("%s\n(%.0f%%)", comma(n), 100 * frac)),
            size = sz(7), colour = "grey15", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nov_fill, name = "Highest-expressed\nRNA isoform") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(c(1.5, 4.5)) +

           size = sz(7), colour = "grey15", lineheight = 0.95) +

        legend.key.size = unit(3.4, "mm"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
save_fig(p_3d, "Fig3d_dominant_isoform_novelty", 2.8, 2.2)
p_3d
```

## 3e, 3f and Extended Data 3g, 3h — per-gene isoform composition donuts

Each isoform is a wedge sized by its share of gene CPM and shaded by novelty (orange
ramp = novel, grey ramp = annotated, darker = higher CPM); the isoform discussed in the
text is outlined and labelled. The transcript models shown next to each donut are
drawn by script 05.

```{r fig3ef_ED3gh_donuts, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_BEST_ORF_CPM)
DONUT_GENES <- c(CABIN1 = "PB.18162.29", CNN1 = "PB.16522.2", RNF5 = "PB.6529.2", HEPH = "PB.18756.6")
DONUT_PANEL <- c(CABIN1 = "Fig3e", CNN1 = "Fig3f", RNF5 = "ED3g", HEPH = "ED3h")

pick <- function(df, pats) { for (p in pats) { h <- names(df)[grepl(p, names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
                                                if (length(h)) return(h[1]) }; NA_character_ }
sp  <- prot %>% mutate(pb = .data[[pick(prot, c("^pb$", "pb_acc", "^isoform$", "pb"))]])
cpm <- read_tsv(F_BEST_ORF_CPM, show_col_types = FALSE)
cpm <- cpm %>% mutate(pb = .data[[pick(cpm, c("pb_acc", "^pb$", "pb"))]])
prot_cpm <- inner_join(sp, cpm, by = "pb", suffix = c(".sp", ".cpm"))
gene_col <- pick(prot_cpm, c("^gene$", "^gene\\.", "gene_name", "gene"))
cpm_col  <- pick(prot_cpm, c("^CPM$", "cpm"))
prot_cpm <- prot_cpm %>% transmute(pb, tx_cat, gene = .data[[gene_col]], CPM = as.numeric(.data[[cpm_col]]))

novel_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FBD9BE", "#F2A35E", "#E8700A"))(20)
annot_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#EDEDED", "#C2C2C2", "#9E9E9E"))(20)
RING_IN <- 2.5; RING_OUT <- 4; X_MIN <- 0.5; X_MAX <- 5.5; CENTRE_X <- 1.2; CALLOUT_X <- 4.8

donut_one <- function(gene_name) {
  gd <- prot_cpm %>% filter(gene == gene_name, CPM > 0) %>%
    mutate(is_novel = tx_cat %in% cat_novel, type = ifelse(is_novel, "Novel", "Annotated"),
           total_gene_CPM = sum(CPM), proportion = CPM / total_gene_CPM * 100)
  if (!nrow(gd)) { message("no CPM>0 isoforms for ", gene_name); return(NULL) }
  target_pb <- DONUT_GENES[[gene_name]]
  gd <- gd %>% mutate(is_target = pb == target_pb) %>%
    arrange(desc(type == "Annotated"), CPM) %>% mutate(plot_order = row_number()) %>%
    group_by(type) %>%
    mutate(type_rank = rank(CPM, ties.method = "first"), n_in_type = n(),
           color_index = pmax(1, pmin(ceiling(type_rank / n_in_type * 20), 20))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(fill_color = ifelse(type == "Novel", novel_colors[color_index], annot_colors[color_index])) %>%
    arrange(plot_order) %>%
    mutate(ymax = cumsum(proportion), ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0), label_pos = (ymin + ymax) / 2)
  write_csv(gd %>% select(gene, pb, tx_cat, type, CPM, proportion, is_target),
            file.path(TABLE_DIR, paste0(DONUT_PANEL[[gene_name]], "_donut_", gene_name, ".csv")))

  tgt <- gd %>% filter(is_target)
  centre_lab <- sprintf(
    paste0("<span style='font-size:9pt'><i>%s</i></span><br>",
           "<span style='color:#666666'>%s CPM</span><br>",
           "<span style='color:#808080'>%d novel / %d known</span>"),
    gene_name, round(unique(gd$total_gene_CPM), 1), sum(gd$is_novel), sum(!gd$is_novel))

  p <- ggplot(gd) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = RING_IN, xmax = RING_OUT, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill_color),
              colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(c(X_MIN, X_MAX)) +
    ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tibble(x = CENTRE_X, y = 0, lab = centre_lab),
                          aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), size = sz(7), lineheight = 1.3,
                          fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) +
    theme_void(base_size = 7) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
  if (nrow(tgt)) p <- p +
    geom_rect(data = tgt, aes(xmin = RING_IN, xmax = RING_OUT, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_label(data = tgt, aes(x = CALLOUT_X, y = label_pos, label = paste0(pb, "\n", round(proportion, 1), "%")),
               colour = "black", fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0, size = sz(7),
               label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"))
  p
}
for (g in names(DONUT_GENES)) {
  pd <- donut_one(g)
  if (!is.null(pd)) { save_fig(pd, paste0(DONUT_PANEL[[g]], "_donut_", g), 2.6, 2.6); print(pd) }
}
```

## Extended Data 3d–f — support for the novel isoforms (length, abundance, quality metrics)

These panels use the full catalog rather than the ≥ 2-donor subset, so that
"≥ 2 donors detected" remains an informative metric instead of 100% by construction.

```{r figED3def_novelty_qc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
aslog <- function(x) { y <- toupper(as.character(x))
  ifelse(y %in% c("TRUE", "T", "YES", "1"), TRUE, ifelse(y %in% c("FALSE", "F", "NO", "0"), FALSE, NA)) }

dat <- rna %>%
  filter(structural_category %in% c(cat_novel, cat_known)) %>%
  mutate(novelty = factor(ifelse(structural_category %in% cat_novel, "Novel", "Annotated"),
                          levels = c("Annotated", "Novel")),
         multidonor   = n_donors >= 2,
         canonical_ok = all_canonical == "canonical",
         not_rts      = !aslog(RTS_stage))
multiexon <- dat %>% filter(exons > 1)
cat(sprintf("Annotated (FSM+ISM): %s | Novel (NIC+NNC): %s\n",
            comma(sum(dat$novelty == "Annotated")), comma(sum(dat$novelty == "Novel"))))

# Extended Data 3f: support metrics (junction and RT-switching metrics on multi-exon isoforms only)
qc_def <- tibble::tribble(
  ~metric,                           ~col,           ~scope,
  ">=2 donors detected",             "multidonor",   "all",
  "All splice junctions canonical",  "canonical_ok", "multiexon",
  "Not RT-switching artifact",       "not_rts",      "multiexon")
summ_one <- function(metric, col, scope) {
  d <- if (scope == "multiexon") multiexon else dat
  if (!(col %in% names(d)) || all(is.na(d[[col]]))) return(NULL)
  d2  <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]))
  tab <- d2 %>% group_by(novelty) %>% summarise(pct = mean(.data[[col]]) * 100, n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(metric = metric,
         Annotated = tab$pct[tab$novelty == "Annotated"], Novel = tab$pct[tab$novelty == "Novel"],
         n_annotated = tab$n[tab$novelty == "Annotated"], n_novel = tab$n[tab$novelty == "Novel"],
         test_p = fisher_p(d2[[col]], d2$novelty))
}
qc_summary <- purrr::pmap_dfr(qc_def, summ_one)
qc_long <- qc_summary %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = rev(metric))) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Annotated, Novel), names_to = "novelty", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(novelty = factor(novelty, levels = c("Annotated", "Novel")))

p_qc <- ggplot(qc_long, aes(metric, pct, fill = novelty)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.64) +
  geom_text(aes(y = pct + 2.5, label = ifelse(pct > 99 & pct < 100, sprintf("%.1f%%", pct), sprintf("%.0f%%", pct))),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), hjust = 0, size = sz(7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nov_fill, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 118), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 18)) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of RNA isoforms") +
  theme_cell(7) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.margin = margin(4, 12, 4, 4))
save_fig(p_qc, "ED3f_novel_support_qc", 2.5, 2)

# Extended Data 3d, 3e: violins (the display window trims the extreme quantiles only)
novel_violin <- function(yvar, title, ylab, digits = 0, lo_q = 0.002, hi_q = 0.995, y_breaks = waiver()) {
  d <- dat %>% transmute(novelty, value = .data[[yvar]]) %>% filter(is.finite(value), value > 0)
  pv  <- wilcox_p(d$value, d$novelty)
  nk  <- sum(d$novelty == "Annotated"); nn <- sum(d$novelty == "Novel")
  med <- d %>% group_by(novelty) %>% summarise(m = median(value), .groups = "drop")
  lo <- unname(quantile(d$value, lo_q, na.rm = TRUE)); hi_ <- unname(quantile(d$value, hi_q, na.rm = TRUE))
  ggplot(d, aes(novelty, value, fill = novelty)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", width = 0.85, colour = NA, trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_label(data = med, aes(x = novelty, y = m, label = comma(round(m, digits))),
               nudge_x = 0.30, fill = "white", colour = "grey15", size = sz(7), label.size = 0,
               label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = nov_fill, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = y_breaks, labels = comma) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(lo, hi_), clip = "on") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sprintf("%s<br><i>n</i> = %s / %s", fmt_p_md(pv), comma(nk), comma(nn)),
         x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_cell(7) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_markdown(), plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 4))
}
save_fig(novel_violin("length", "RNA isoform length", expression("RNA isoform length (bp, log"[10]*")"),
                      y_breaks = c(300, 1000, 3000, 10000)),
```

# Figure 4 — noncoding CAD variants produce coding changes

Fig. 4b (schematic), 4i/4k (browser tracks) and 4j/4l (AlphaFold3) are made elsewhere.

## 4a — genomic location of the 304 unique CAD sQTL lead SNPs

Each SNP position is classified against GENCODE v38 with the priority CDS > exon >
intron > intergenic, one row per unique SNP, so that a SNP overlapping the CDS of any
transcript of the gene counts as coding (Methods, "Mapping CAD sQTL junctions to
transcripts and proteins"). The GTF overlap takes a few minutes, so the classification
is cached in `TABLE_DIR`; delete the cache or set `FORCE_RECLASSIFY <- TRUE` to redo it.

```{r fig4a_snp_location, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
FORCE_RECLASSIFY <- FALSE
SNP_CLASS_OUT <- file.path(TABLE_DIR, "snp_location_classification.csv")

snp_col <- base::intersect(c("SNP_ID", "rsid"), names(lfc_m))[1]
snp_combos <- lfc_m %>%
  mutate(SNP_ID = .data[[snp_col]], pos = suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SNP_ID), SNP_ID != "", !is.na(pos)) %>%
  distinct(SNP_ID, chr, pos, junction_key, gene_name)

if (!FORCE_RECLASSIFY && file.exists(SNP_CLASS_OUT)) {
  snp_class <- read_csv(SNP_CLASS_OUT, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  require_files(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF)
  suppressMessages(library(GenomicRanges))
  hdr <- readLines(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF, n = 200)
  n_comment <- which(!startsWith(hdr, "#"))[1] - 1L; if (is.na(n_comment)) n_comment <- 0L
  g <- data.table::fread(file = F_GENCODE_V38_GTF, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "",
                         skip = n_comment, showProgress = FALSE,
                         col.names = c("seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attr"))
  stopifnot("GTF did not parse into 9 columns" = ncol(g) == 9L)
  g <- g[feature %in% c("gene", "exon", "CDS")]
  mk <- function(ft) { d <- g[feature == ft]
    GenomicRanges::reduce(GRanges(as.character(d$seqname), IRanges(d$start, d$end)), ignore.strand = TRUE) }
  cds_gr <- mk("CDS"); exon_gr <- mk("exon"); gene_gr <- mk("gene")
  snps <- snp_combos %>% distinct(chr, pos)
  snp_gr <- GRanges(as.character(snps$chr), IRanges(snps$pos, snps$pos))
  snps <- snps %>% mutate(
    in_cds  = IRanges::overlapsAny(snp_gr, cds_gr,  ignore.strand = TRUE),
    in_exon = IRanges::overlapsAny(snp_gr, exon_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE),
    in_gene = IRanges::overlapsAny(snp_gr, gene_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE),
    snp_region = dplyr::case_when(in_cds ~ "CDS (coding)", in_exon ~ "Exonic noncoding (UTR/ncRNA)",
                                  in_gene ~ "Intronic", TRUE ~ "Intergenic"),
    snp_coding = ifelse(in_cds, "Coding", "Noncoding"))
  snp_class <- snp_combos %>% left_join(snps, by = c("chr", "pos"))
  write_csv(snp_class, SNP_CLASS_OUT)
  rm(g, cds_gr, exon_gr, gene_gr); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  bind_dplyr()   # GenomicRanges masks dplyr verbs
}

snp_region_lv <- c("CDS (coding)", "Exonic noncoding (UTR/ncRNA)", "Intronic", "Intergenic")
region_rank   <- setNames(seq_along(snp_region_lv), snp_region_lv)
snp_unique <- snp_class %>%
  mutate(rrank = region_rank[snp_region]) %>%
  arrange(SNP_ID, rrank) %>%
  group_by(SNP_ID) %>% filter(row_number() == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(snp_region = factor(snp_region, levels = snp_region_lv),
         snp_coding = ifelse(snp_region == "CDS (coding)", "Coding", "Noncoding"))

loc <- snp_unique %>% count(snp_region, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(snp_region) %>%
  mutate(ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0), mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2)
cat(sprintf("Fig 4a: %d unique CAD sQTL SNPs\n", nrow(snp_unique))); print(loc %>% select(snp_region, n, pct))
write_csv(loc %>% select(snp_region, n, pct), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4a_snp_location_summary.csv"))

loc_pal <- c("CDS (coding)" = GREEN[["base"]], "Exonic noncoding (UTR/ncRNA)" = "#B8CFC5",
             "Intronic" = "#9E9E9E", "Intergenic" = "#D4D4D4")
n_snp_u    <- nrow(snp_unique)
noncod_pct <- round(sum(snp_unique$snp_coding == "Noncoding") / n_snp_u * 100)

p_snploc <- ggplot(loc) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 3, xmax = 4, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = snp_region), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.5, y = mid, label = ifelse(n >= 4, n, "")), colour = "grey15", size = sz(7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = loc_pal, name = "SNP location") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(c(1.5, 4.5)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0, label = paste0("n = ", comma(n_snp_u)), size = sz(8), colour = "grey15") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.05, y = 0, label = "unique\nsQTL SNPs", size = sz(6.5), colour = "grey40", lineheight = 0.9) +
  labs(subtitle = sprintf("%d%% of sQTL SNPs are noncoding", noncod_pct)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 7), legend.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey15"),
        legend.key.size = unit(3.4, "mm"), legend.position = "right",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0, colour = "grey15", margin = margin(b = 4)),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
save_fig(p_snploc, "Fig4a_snp_location", w = 4.6, h = 2.6)
p_snploc
```

## 4d — coding versus noncoding junctions, by long-read capture

"Coding" here means that the junction overlaps GENCODE-annotated CDS, a definition
available for all 355 junctions (unlike the long-read ORF-based class used for 4e).

```{r fig4d_coding_capture, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
coding_keys <- cds_class$junction_key[cds_class$overlaps_cds %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE")]
cap_levels  <- c("In long-read (carried forward)", "Annotation only")

cc <- junction_master %>%
  mutate(coding  = factor(ifelse(junction_key %in% coding_keys, "Coding", "Noncoding"), levels = c("Coding", "Noncoding")),
         capture = factor(ifelse(lr_captured, cap_levels[1], cap_levels[2]), levels = cap_levels)) %>%
  count(coding, capture) %>%
  group_by(coding) %>% arrange(capture, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(ypos = rev(cumsum(rev(n))) - n / 2) %>% ungroup()
totals <- cc %>% group_by(coding) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("does not sum to 355" = sum(cc$n) == 355)
write_csv(cc %>% select(coding, capture, n), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4d_coding_by_capture.csv"))

p4d <- ggplot(cc, aes(coding, n, fill = capture)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = comma(n), colour = ifelse(capture == "Annotation only", "grey20", "grey15")), size = sz(7)) +
  geom_text(data = totals, aes(coding, n, label = comma(n)), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.6, size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annotation only" = "#D4D4D4", "In long-read (carried forward)" = "#8A7FA8"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)), labels = comma) +
  labs(title = sprintf("CAD sQTL junctions (n = %s)", comma(sum(cc$n))), x = NULL, y = "Number of junctions") +
  theme_cell(7) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), plot.title = element_text(size = 7.5))
save_fig(p4d, "Fig4d_coding_by_capture", 2.8, 2.4)
p4d
```

## 4e — predicted junction consequence among the 146 long-read-captured junctions

Reads `dom` (one dominant call per junction, from the junction master). Junctions that
received no call are grouped with "Complex / other"; the composition of that wedge is
exported for the legend.

```{r fig4e_effect_donut, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
universe <- junction_master$junction_key[junction_master$lr_captured]
stopifnot(length(universe) == 146)

PE_PAL  <- c("ES / inclusion in ORF" = GREEN[["dark"]], "Alt splice site in ORF" = GREEN[["base"]],
             "AFE/ALE in ORF" = GREEN[["mid"]], "Complex / other" = GREY[["mid"]],
             "Non-coding splice event" = GREY[["dark"]])
PE_DISP <- c("ES / inclusion in ORF" = "Exon skipping or inclusion", "Alt splice site in ORF" = "Alternative splice site",
             "AFE/ALE in ORF" = "Alternative first or last exon", "Complex / other" = "Complex or unclassified",
             "Non-coding splice event" = "Noncoding splice event")
ORF_ALTERING <- c("ES / inclusion in ORF", "Alt splice site in ORF", "AFE/ALE in ORF")

pe <- tibble(junction_key = universe) %>%
  left_join(dom, by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(effect = ifelse(is.na(protein_effect), "Complex / other", protein_effect)) %>%
  count(effect, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(effect, levels = intersect(names(PE_PAL), effect))) %>%
  arrange(label) %>%
  mutate(ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0), mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
         txt_col = ifelse(as.character(label) %in% c("ES / inclusion in ORF", "Alt splice site in ORF", "Non-coding splice event"),
                          "white", "grey15"),
         label_disp = factor(PE_DISP[as.character(label)], levels = unname(PE_DISP)))
PE_PAL_DISP <- setNames(unname(PE_PAL[as.character(pe$label)]), as.character(pe$label_disp))
n_orf <- sum(pe$n[as.character(pe$label) %in% ORF_ALTERING]); total_n <- sum(pe$n)
cat(sprintf("Fig 4e: %d of %d junctions (%.0f%%) predicted to alter the ORF\n", n_orf, total_n, 100 * n_orf / total_n))
write_csv(pe %>% select(effect, label_disp, n), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4e_protein_effects_plotted.csv"))

pPE <- ggplot(pe) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 3, xmax = 4, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = label_disp), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.5, y = mid, label = ifelse(n >= 8, n, ""), colour = txt_col), size = sz(7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = PE_PAL_DISP, name = "Predicted junction consequence") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(c(1.5, 4.5)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0,
           label = sprintf("%d of %d\njunctions\n(%.0f%%) predicted\nto alter the ORF", n_orf, total_n, 100 * n_orf / total_n),
           size = sz(7), colour = "grey15", lineheight = 0.95) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 7), legend.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey15"),
        legend.key.size = unit(3.4, "mm"), legend.position = "right",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
save_fig(pPE, "Fig4e_protein_effects_donut", 4.6, 2.4)
pPE
```

## 4f — junction overlap with protein features (CAD versus non-CAD VSMC sQTL junctions)

The ±30-bp overlap with UniProt domains, secondary-structure elements and disordered
regions, with Fisher's exact test, is computed in script 03; this chunk plots the three
rows of that aggregate table.

```{r fig4f_feature_overlap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_AGGREGATE_JUNCTION)
jres <- read_csv(OUT_AGGREGATE_JUNCTION, show_col_types = FALSE)

# binary overlap properties are stored as proportions (0-1) in the median columns
nm <- names(jres)
pct_cad_col <- nm[str_detect(nm, regex("(pct|prop|percent|frac).*cad(?!.*non)|cad.*(pct|prop|percent|frac)", ignore_case = TRUE)) & !str_detect(nm, "non")][1]
pct_non_col <- nm[str_detect(nm, regex("non.*(pct|prop|percent|frac)|(pct|prop|percent|frac).*non", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
base <- if (!is.na(pct_cad_col) && !is.na(pct_non_col)) {
  jres %>% transmute(property_label, CAD = .data[[pct_cad_col]], nonCAD = .data[[pct_non_col]], p_value, n_cad, n_noncad)
} else if (all(c("median_cad", "median_noncad") %in% nm)) {
  jres %>% transmute(property_label, CAD = median_cad * 100, nonCAD = median_noncad * 100, p_value, n_cad, n_noncad)
} else stop("Cannot find CAD/nonCAD percentage columns in ", basename(OUT_AGGREGATE_JUNCTION))

# the three +/-30 bp overlap properties (anchored so "Domain category:" rows do not match)
WANT <- c("Protein Domain" = "^Protein Domain", "Secondary Structure" = "^Secondary Structure",
          "Disordered Region" = "^Disordered Region")
pick_label <- function(pat) { hit <- unique(base$property_label)[str_detect(unique(base$property_label), regex(pat, ignore_case = TRUE))]
                              if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_ }
sel <- tibble(display = names(WANT), pat = unname(WANT)) %>% mutate(property_label = map_chr(pat, pick_label))
stopifnot("could not match all three properties" = !any(is.na(sel$property_label)))

bar <- base %>% inner_join(sel, by = "property_label") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(CAD, nonCAD), names_to = "group", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(ifelse(group == "nonCAD", "Non-CAD", "CAD"), levels = c("Non-CAD", "CAD")),
         display = factor(display, levels = rev(names(WANT))),
         sig = star_p(p_value))
write_csv(bar, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4f_junction_overlap_features.csv"))

p_bar <- ggplot(bar, aes(display, pct, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.72), width = 0.66, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", pct)), position = position_dodge(0.72), hjust = -0.15, size = sz(7)) +
  geom_text(data = bar %>% group_by(display, sig) %>% summarise(y = max(pct), .groups = "drop"),
            aes(x = display, y = y + 11, label = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = sz(7), colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CAD" = COL_PANEL$cad, "Non-CAD" = COL_PANEL$neutral), breaks = c("CAD", "Non-CAD"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 62), breaks = seq(0, 60, 20), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage of junctions (%)", title = "Junction overlap with protein features",
       subtitle = sprintf("*n* CAD = %s, non-CAD = %s", comma(first(bar$n_cad)), comma(first(bar$n_noncad)))) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.key.size = unit(2.6, "mm"),
        legend.margin = margin(b = -4), legend.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 1), plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE, face = "plain"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = BASE_SIZE - 1.5, colour = "grey35"),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
save_fig(p_bar, "Fig4f_junction_overlap_features", w = 2, h = 2.6)
```

## 4g — coding CAD sQTL junctions with distinguishing peptide evidence (n = 133)

For each probeable junction, script 05 compared the long-read isoforms carrying the
risk-associated junction with those carrying the nonrisk-associated junction and
recorded on which side at least one distinguishing peptide was detected. Percentages
are of the 133 probeable junctions.

```{r fig4g_peptide_sides, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
N_DENOM <- sum(junction_master$probeable)   # 133 coding CAD sQTL junctions
SIDE_LV  <- c("Risk only", "Nonrisk only", "Both sides")
SIDE_LAB <- c("Risk only" = "Risk", "Nonrisk only" = "Nonrisk", "Both sides" = "Both")
SIDE_COL <- c("Risk only" = COL_PANEL$risk, "Nonrisk only" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk, "Both sides" = COL_PANEL$cad)

valC <- junction_master %>%
  filter(probeable) %>%
  count(side) %>%
  filter(side %in% SIDE_LV) %>%
  mutate(side = factor(side, levels = SIDE_LV),
         pct = 100 * n / N_DENOM, lab = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", n, pct))
n_val <- sum(valC$n)
cat(sprintf("Fig 4g: %d of %d coding CAD sQTL junctions (%.1f%%) with a distinguishing peptide\n",
            n_val, N_DENOM, 100 * n_val / N_DENOM))
write_csv(valC %>% select(side, n, pct), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4g_distinguishing_peptides.csv"))

p_4g <- ggplot(valC, aes(side, n, fill = side)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d\n(%.0f%%)", n, pct)), vjust = -0.25, size = sz(7), lineheight = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SIDE_COL, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = SIDE_LAB) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(x = "Set with a distinguishing peptide", y = "CAD sQTL junctions",
       title = "Peptide evidence",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d of %d junctions (%.0f%%)", n_val, N_DENOM, 100 * n_val / N_DENOM)) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(lineheight = 0.9),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 0.5, colour = "grey30"))
save_fig(p_4g, "Fig4g_distinguishing_peptides", 2.0, 2.4)
```

## 4h — direction of the dominant property change (82 of 94 pairs)

Fill encodes direction with the risk/nonrisk colours; the property family is the row
grouping. Manual AP-MS pairs are excluded so that the count matches the 94 computed
pairs described in the text.

```{r fig4h_direction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DIR_LV  <- c("Risk increased", "Risk decreased")
DIR_COL <- c("Risk increased" = COL_PANEL$risk, "Risk decreased" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk)

fam_div <- pair_modes %>%
  filter(!gated, !is.na(mode_family)) %>%
  mutate(dir_grp = factor(ifelse(mode_oriented > 0, "Risk increased", "Risk decreased"), levels = DIR_LV)) %>%
  count(mode_family, dir_grp, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(signed = ifelse(dir_grp == "Risk increased", n, -n)) %>%
  group_by(mode_family) %>% mutate(fam_tot = sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(mode_family = fct_reorder(mode_family, fam_tot))
n_dom  <- sum(!pair_modes$gated, na.rm = TRUE)
n_gate <- sum(pair_modes$gated,  na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Fig 4h: %d pairs with a dominant mode; %d minimal or mixed\n", n_dom, n_gate))
write_csv(fam_div %>% select(mode_family, dir_grp, n), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4h_dominant_change_direction.csv"))

p_famdiv <- ggplot(fam_div, aes(signed, mode_family, fill = dir_grp)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = abs(signed), hjust = ifelse(signed > 0, -0.3, 1.3)), size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DIR_COL, breaks = DIR_LV, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = abs, limits = c(-26, 16), breaks = seq(-20, 10, 10)) +
  labs(x = "Number of pairs", y = NULL, title = "Dominant change",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d of %d pairs", n_dom, n_dom + n_gate)) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.size = unit(2.6, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 0.5),
        legend.margin = margin(t = -2), legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = BASE_SIZE + 1),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## Numbers for the text (junction → isoform mapping)

For the 146 long-read-captured junctions, the share whose carrying isoforms include at
least one novel (NIC/NNC) transcript, and the share of all junction-assigned isoforms
that are novel.

```{r fig4_text_numbers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
iso_cat  <- rna %>% transmute(pb_id = str_extract(isoform, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"), cat = structural_category)
novel_pb <- unique(iso_cat$pb_id[iso_cat$cat %in% cat_novel])

lr_map <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(as.character(pb_id), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id))

jn <- lr_map %>%
  filter(junction_key %in% junction_master$junction_key[junction_master$lr_captured]) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(n_isoforms = n_distinct(pb_id),
            n_novel    = n_distinct(pb_id[pb_id %in% novel_pb]),
            any_novel  = n_novel > 0, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("LR-captured junction count changed" = nrow(jn) == sum(junction_master$lr_captured))
cat(sprintf("%d of %d LR-captured junctions (%.0f%%) carried >= 1 novel (NIC/NNC) isoform\n",
            sum(jn$any_novel), nrow(jn), 100 * mean(jn$any_novel)))
iso_assigned <- lr_map %>% filter(junction_key %in% jn$junction_key) %>% distinct(pb_id)
cat(sprintf("%d of %d junction-assigned isoforms (%.0f%%) are novel\n",
            sum(iso_assigned$pb_id %in% novel_pb), nrow(iso_assigned),
            100 * mean(iso_assigned$pb_id %in% novel_pb)))
write_csv(jn, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig4_novel_isoform_per_LR_junction.csv"))
```

# Extended Data Figure 4 — peptide evidence for CAD sQTL isoforms

Panels 4b–e (browser tracks, AlphaFold3) are made elsewhere.

## 4a — peptide evidence per CAD sGene by isoform class

Rows: Risk (peptide exclusive to the risk-junction isoforms), Nonrisk, Shared (sequence
present in both sets). Point size is the number of distinct peptides; an asterisk marks
at least one IS-PRM detection in that group. Genes are ordered by evidence tier (both
sides supported, one side, shared only).

```{r figED4a_peptide_dotplot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
STATUS_LV  <- c("Risk", "Nonrisk", "Shared")
STATUS_COL <- c(Risk = COL_PANEL$risk, Nonrisk = COL_PANEL$nonrisk, Shared = COL_PANEL$cad)
pep_dot <- detail %>%
  mutate(status = dplyr::recode(as.character(peptide_class), "Both (shared)" = "Shared", "Non-Risk" = "Nonrisk")) %>%
  filter(status %in% STATUS_LV) %>%
  group_by(gene = gene_symbol, status) %>%
  summarise(n_pep = n_distinct(peptide), any_isprm = any(detected_by == "IS-PRM"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = STATUS_LV), shape_lab = ifelse(any_isprm, "IS-PRM", "Discovery"))
tiers <- pep_dot %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(has_risk = any(status == "Risk" & n_pep > 0), has_nonrisk = any(status == "Nonrisk" & n_pep > 0),
            has_shared = any(status == "Shared" & n_pep > 0), tot = sum(n_pep), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tier = case_when(has_risk & has_nonrisk ~ 1L, has_risk | has_nonrisk ~ 2L, has_shared ~ 3L, TRUE ~ 4L))
write_csv(pep_dot %>% left_join(tiers %>% select(gene, tier), by = "gene"), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED4a_peptide_evidence_dotplot.csv"))

ord <- tiers %>% arrange(tier, desc(tot)) %>% pull(gene)
d <- pep_dot %>% mutate(gene = factor(sprintf("*%s*", gene), levels = sprintf("*%s*", ord)))
p_pepdot <- ggplot(d, aes(gene, status)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_pep, colour = status, shape = shape_lab)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = STATUS_COL, breaks = STATUS_LV, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("IS-PRM" = 8, "Discovery" = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 2.0, name = "Distinct peptides") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(STATUS_LV)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.2)), shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.2))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Peptide evidence by gene and peptide class") +
  theme_cell(7) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey92"),
        axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
save_fig(p_pepdot, "ED4a_peptide_evidence_dotplot", 7.5, 1.5)
```
