# Extended Data Figure 5 — splice event classes, NMD status and isoform property differences

## 5a — alternative-splicing event class, CAD versus non-CAD VSMC sQTL clusters

The overall χ² test and the per-class Fisher tests (BH-corrected) are exported; the
statistics are reported in the legend rather than drawn on the panel.

```{r figED5a_as_classes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_AS_DISTRIBUTION)
as_df <- read_csv(OUT_AS_DISTRIBUTION, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(as_type_B = ifelse(is.na(as_type_B), "NA", as.character(as_type_B)), pct = as.numeric(pct))
as_ct <- as_df %>% group_by(group, as_type_B) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
ct_mat <- as.matrix(as_ct[setdiff(names(as_ct), "as_type_B")]); rownames(ct_mat) <- as_ct$as_type_B
overall_chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct_mat))
per_type <- purrr::map_dfr(as_ct$as_type_B, function(t) {
  this <- ct_mat[t, , drop = FALSE]; rest <- colSums(ct_mat[rownames(ct_mat) != t, , drop = FALSE])
  ft <- suppressWarnings(fisher.test(rbind(this, rest)))
  tibble(as_type = t, odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value)
}) %>% mutate(fisher_p_BH = p.adjust(fisher_p, "BH"), sig = star(fisher_p_BH))
n_cad    <- sum(as_df$n[!grepl("non", as_df$group, ignore.case = TRUE)])
n_noncad <- sum(as_df$n[ grepl("non", as_df$group, ignore.case = TRUE)])
cat(sprintf("ED 5a: chi-square P = %.3g | n clusters CAD = %s, non-CAD = %s\n", overall_chi$p.value, comma(n_cad), comma(n_noncad)))
write_csv(per_type %>% arrange(fisher_p_BH), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5a_as_type_per_class_fisher.csv"))
write_csv(tibble(test = "chi-square (overall)", statistic = unname(overall_chi$statistic),
                 df = unname(overall_chi$parameter), p_value = overall_chi$p.value),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5a_as_type_overall_chisq.csv"))

as_df$group <- factor(ifelse(grepl("non", as_df$group, ignore.case = TRUE), "Non-CAD", "CAD"), levels = c("CAD", "Non-CAD"))
ord <- as_df %>% group_by(as_type_B) %>% summarise(tot = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(tot)) %>% pull(as_type_B)
tail_lv <- intersect(c("complex", "NA"), ord); ord <- c(setdiff(ord, tail_lv), tail_lv)
as_df <- as_df %>%
  mutate(as_type_B = factor(as_type_B, levels = rev(ord)),
         seg_lab = ifelse(pct >= 4, sprintf("%s\n(%d%%)", comma(n), round(pct)), ""))
AS_PAL <- c("ES" = GREEN[["mid"]], "AAS" = GREEN[["light"]], "ADS" = "#DDE6E0", "MXE" = "#EEF2EF",
            "complex" = GREY[["mid"]], "NA" = GREY[["light"]])
sig_lookup <- per_type %>% transmute(as_type, sig = ifelse(is.na(sig) | sig == "ns", "", sig))
leg_labs <- setNames(vapply(ord, function(t) { s <- sig_lookup$sig[sig_lookup$as_type == t]
                                               if (length(s) && s != "") paste0(t, " ", s) else t }, character(1)), ord)

pAS <- ggplot(as_df, aes(group, pct, fill = as_type_B)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = seg_lab), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), colour = "grey15", size = sz(7), lineheight = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = AS_PAL[intersect(names(AS_PAL), ord)], name = "AS type", breaks = ord, labels = leg_labs) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage of clusters (%)", title = "Alternative splicing event class") +
  s5_theme(7) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top"))
save_fig(pAS, "ED5a_as_event_types", 2.2, 2.6)
pAS
```

## 5b — predicted NMD status (majority vote across the junction's isoforms)

```{r figED5b_nmd, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_NMD_CAD_MAJORITY, OUT_NMD_NONCAD_MAJORITY)
nmd_cad    <- read_csv(OUT_NMD_CAD_MAJORITY,    show_col_types = FALSE)
nmd_noncad <- read_csv(OUT_NMD_NONCAD_MAJORITY, show_col_types = FALSE)
NMD_COLS <- c("NMD" = GREEN[["base"]], "Non-NMD" = GREY[["light"]])

cad_nmd <- sum(nmd_cad$majority_nmd);    cad_non    <- nrow(nmd_cad)    - cad_nmd
noncad_nmd <- sum(nmd_noncad$majority_nmd); noncad_non <- nrow(nmd_noncad) - noncad_nmd
nmd_p <- fisher.test(matrix(c(cad_nmd, cad_non, noncad_nmd, noncad_non), nrow = 2))$p.value
cat(sprintf("ED 5b: NMD %d/%d CAD vs %d/%d non-CAD; Fisher P = %.3g\n", cad_nmd, nrow(nmd_cad), noncad_nmd, nrow(nmd_noncad), nmd_p))

nmd_df <- tibble(group = rep(c("CAD", "Non-CAD"), each = 2), status = rep(c("NMD", "Non-NMD"), 2),
                 n = c(cad_nmd, cad_non, noncad_nmd, noncad_non)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CAD", "Non-CAD")), status = factor(status, levels = c("NMD", "Non-NMD")),
         lab = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", n, pct)) %>%
  arrange(group, desc(status)) %>% group_by(group) %>% mutate(ypos = cumsum(pct) - pct / 2) %>% ungroup()
write_csv(nmd_df %>% select(-ypos) %>% mutate(fisher_p = nmd_p), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5b_nmd_status.csv"))

p_nmd <- ggplot(nmd_df, aes(group, pct, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = lab), colour = "grey15", size = sz(7), lineheight = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = NMD_COLS, name = "Status") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage of junctions (%)", title = "Predicted NMD status") +
  s5_theme(7) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top"))
save_fig(p_nmd, "ED5b_nmd_status", 2.6, 2.6)
p_nmd
```

## 5c — peptide evidence for isoforms with notable features, by pair role

Script 05 defines the peptide-supported isoforms with novel-transcript, novel-protein,
predicted-NMD or retained-intron features (one isoform may carry several). The colour
added here states whether the isoform is the representative risk- or nonrisk-associated
isoform of a pair (script 06) or another member of the risk- or nonrisk-junction set.
A distinguishing peptide is exclusive to a set rather than to a single isoform, so the
grey category keeps the panel from reading as individually validated isoforms.

```{r figED5c_features_by_role, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
risk_set    <- unique(na.omit(pairs$risk_pb))
nonrisk_set <- unique(na.omit(pairs$nonrisk_pb))
ROLE_LV   <- c("Risk-associated isoform", "Nonrisk-associated isoform", "Other isoform")
ROLE_COLS <- setNames(c(COL_PANEL$risk, COL_PANEL$nonrisk, GREY[["mid"]]), ROLE_LV)
cand <- cand %>%
  select(-any_of("sqtl_role")) %>%
  mutate(sqtl_role = factor(case_when(pb_id %in% risk_set    ~ ROLE_LV[1],
                                      pb_id %in% nonrisk_set ~ ROLE_LV[2],
                                      TRUE                   ~ ROLE_LV[3]), levels = ROLE_LV))

# every candidate isoform must sit in the risk or nonrisk set of some cluster
in_set <- detail %>%
  filter(peptide_class %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk")) %>%
  separate_rows(isoforms_evidenced, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  pull(isoforms_evidenced) %>% unique()
cat(sprintf("ED 5c: %d isoforms across %d genes | in a risk/nonrisk set: %d | pair representatives: %d\n",
            nrow(cand), n_distinct(cand$gene), sum(cand$pb_id %in% in_set),
            sum(cand$sqtl_role != ROLE_LV[3])))
stopifnot("candidate isoform outside both junction sets" = all(cand$pb_id %in% in_set))

feat_levels <- c("Novel transcript", "Novel protein", "NMD", "Retained intron")
feat_long <- cand %>%
  transmute(pb_id, sqtl_role, `Novel transcript` = novel_tx, `Novel protein` = novel_protein,
            `NMD` = nmd, `Retained intron` = retained_intron) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(pb_id, sqtl_role), names_to = "feature", values_to = "has") %>%
  filter(has) %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = feat_levels))
feat_tot <- feat_long %>% count(feature, name = "n")
feat_seg <- feat_long %>% count(feature, sqtl_role, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(feature, desc(sqtl_role)) %>% group_by(feature) %>% mutate(ypos = cumsum(n) - n / 2) %>% ungroup()
write_csv(feat_seg %>% select(-ypos), file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5c_features_by_role.csv"))
write_csv(cand %>% select(gene, pb_id, sqtl_role, novel_tx, novel_protein, nmd, retained_intron, n_excl_pep, via_isprm, via_dda),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5c_supported_isoforms.csv"))

p_feat <- ggplot(feat_long, aes(feature, fill = sqtl_role)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.7, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = feat_seg, aes(feature, ypos, label = n), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  geom_text(data = feat_tot, aes(feature, n, label = n), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ROLE_COLS, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Peptide-supported isoforms",
       title = "Peptide evidence for isoforms with notable features",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d isoforms across %d genes with a distinguishing peptide; features overlap",
                          nrow(cand), n_distinct(cand$gene))) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
        legend.key.size = unit(3.2, "mm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 1, colour = "grey30")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
save_fig(p_feat, "ED5c_features_by_role", w = 4, h = 2.8)
p_feat
```

## 5d — property-difference heatmap for the 94 risk/nonrisk pairs

Reads the scaled risk − nonrisk property differences, the property axis order and the
pairwise sequence/structure similarity exported by script 06. Similarity forms the
first two columns and carries the row labels; rows are grouped by dominant property
family and ordered by the strength of the dominant change.

```{r figED5d_pair_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_PAIR_SIGNATURES_LONG, OUT_PROPERTY_AXIS_ORDER, OUT_PAIR_SIMILARITY)
axis_ord  <- read_csv(OUT_PROPERTY_AXIS_ORDER, show_col_types = FALSE)
FAM_ORDER <- c("Fold & disorder", "Domains", "PTM", "Biochemistry", "Localization", "Other", "Minimal")
sig <- read_csv(OUT_PAIR_SIGNATURES_LONG, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^﻿", "", .x)) %>%
  filter(pair_type != "manual_apms")

pair_lab_tbl <- sig %>%
  distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, pair_type, mode_family, mode_strength, gated) %>%
  mutate(gene_disp = display_gene(gene_name)) %>%
  group_by(gene_disp) %>%
  mutate(pair_lab = if (n() > 1) sprintf("%s (%d)", gene_disp, row_number()) else gene_disp) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(-gene_disp)
stopifnot("expected 94 sQTL-derived pairs" = nrow(pair_lab_tbl) == 94)

hm <- sig %>%
  left_join(pair_lab_tbl %>% select(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, pair_lab), by = c("gene_name", "risk_pb", "nonrisk_pb")) %>%
  mutate(axis = factor(axis, levels = axis_ord$axis),
         mode_family = factor(ifelse(gated, "Minimal", as.character(mode_family)),
                              levels = intersect(FAM_ORDER, c(as.character(mode_family), "Minimal"))),
         z = pmax(pmin(score, 3), -3))
ord <- hm %>% distinct(pair_lab, mode_family, mode_strength) %>% arrange(mode_family, desc(mode_strength)) %>% pull(pair_lab)
hm <- hm %>% mutate(pair_lab = factor(pair_lab, levels = rev(ord)))
cat(sprintf("ED 5d: %d pairs x %d axes | %d families\n", n_distinct(hm$pair_lab), n_distinct(hm$axis), n_distinct(hm$mode_family)))

heat_theme <- theme_cell(7) +
  theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, size = 6, colour = "grey15", face = "plain"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "plain"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.width = unit(2.6, "mm"), legend.key.height = unit(5, "mm"))

# similarity z-scored across all pairs in the file
sim <- read_csv(OUT_PAIR_SIMILARITY, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, struct_sim, seq_sim) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(struct_sim, seq_sim), names_to = "metric", values_to = "v") %>%
  filter(is.finite(v)) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>% mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(v))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(pair_lab_tbl %>% select(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, pair_lab, mode_family, gated),
             by = c("gene_name", "risk_pb", "nonrisk_pb")) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("seq_sim", "struct_sim"), labels = c("Sequence", "Structure")),
         mode_family = factor(ifelse(gated, "Minimal", as.character(mode_family)), levels = levels(hm$mode_family)),
         pair_lab = factor(pair_lab, levels = levels(hm$pair_lab)))
stopifnot("no similarity rows matched the 94 pairs" = nrow(sim) > 0)
p_sim <- ggplot(sim, aes(metric, pair_lab, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(mode_family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = GREEN[["base"]], name = "Similarity\n(z)") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  heat_theme + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4.3, colour = "grey15"), strip.text = element_blank())

p_main <- ggplot(hm, aes(axis, pair_lab, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(mode_family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = COL_PANEL$nonrisk, mid = "white", high = COL_PANEL$risk, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-3, 3),
                       name = "Scaled difference\n(risk − nonrisk)") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  heat_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 6, colour = "grey15", face = "plain"))

p_ED5d <- p_sim + p_main + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 6), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "mm"))
save_fig(p_ED5d, "ED5d_pair_property_heatmap", 4.4, 8.5)
write_csv(hm %>% select(pair_lab, gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, mode_family, mode_strength, axis, score, z),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ED5d_pair_property_heatmap_data.csv"))
```

## 5b — VSMC expression support for the interactors

Each interactor is scored by the number of VSMC evidence sources supporting it (HPA
smooth-muscle annotation, VSMC discovery proteomics, VSMC long-read RNA-seq), as
annotated in script 07. The control bait is excluded.

```{r fig5b_vsmc_support, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(OUT_PREY_VSMC_SUPPORT)
sup <- read_csv(OUT_PREY_VSMC_SUPPORT, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!Bait %in% "RAB11B-3xFLAG") %>%
  distinct(PreyGene, specificity, In_SMCs_in_HPA, `SMC Protein`, `SMC LR RNAseq`) %>%
  mutate(n_support = (In_SMCs_in_HPA == "YES") + (`SMC Protein` == "YES") + (`SMC LR RNAseq` == "YES"),
         support = factor(case_when(n_support == 3 ~ "All three", n_support == 2 ~ "Two",
                                    n_support == 1 ~ "One", TRUE ~ "None"),
                          levels = c("All three", "Two", "One", "None")),
         specificity = factor(specificity, levels = SPEC_LV, labels = SPEC_LAB))
sup_ct <- sup %>% count(specificity, support) %>%
  arrange(specificity, desc(support)) %>% group_by(specificity) %>% mutate(ypos = cumsum(n) - n / 2) %>% ungroup()
tot <- sup_ct %>% group_by(specificity) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("Fig 5b: interactor entries %d | >=1 VSMC measure %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            nrow(sup), sum(sup$n_support > 0), 100 * mean(sup$n_support > 0)))
write_csv(sup, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "Fig5b_vsmc_support_per_interactor.csv"))

SUP_PAL <- c("All three" = GREEN[["base"]], "Two" = GREEN[["mid"]], "One" = GREEN[["light"]], "None" = GREY[["dark"]])
p_5b <- ggplot(sup_ct, aes(specificity, n, fill = support)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = ifelse(n >= 20, n, "")), size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  geom_text(data = tot, aes(specificity, n, label = n), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.5, size = sz(7), colour = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SUP_PAL, name = "VSMC evidence") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("-", "-\n", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of interactors", title = "VSMC support for interactors",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d of %d (%.1f%%) with ≥1 measure",
                          sum(sup$n_support > 0), nrow(sup), 100 * mean(sup$n_support > 0))) +
  theme_cell(BASE_SIZE) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(3.2, "mm"), plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey30"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, lineheight = 0.85, vjust = 1))
save_fig(p_5b, "Fig5b_vsmc_support", w = 2.3, h = 1.9)
p_5b
```

# Figure 6 — SRP54, MLX and ITGA1 vignettes

Fig. 6a/6f/6k (browser tracks), 6d/6e/6i/6j/6n/6o (structures), 6p (schematic) and 6q
(images) are made elsewhere.

## 6.0 AP-MS spectral counts

SRP complex members come from the SRP54 pulldown table; the MLX and ITGA1 panels come
from the SAINTexpress output, in which `Spec` holds the per-replicate bait counts and
`ctrlCounts` the control pulldowns. Every prey × group combination is completed so that
a lost or gained interaction shows a zero bar (the control n therefore includes imputed
zeros for preys absent from a control run).

```{r fig6_apms_load, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_SRP54_SPECTRAL, F_SAINT_SET)
srp_complex_apms <- read_csv(F_SRP54_SPECTRAL, show_col_types = FALSE)
srp_all_long <- bind_rows(
  srp_complex_apms %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("Spec"), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    transmute(PreyGene, value = as.numeric(value), group = as.character(status)),
  srp_complex_apms %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("ctrlCounts"), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    transmute(PreyGene, value = as.numeric(value), group = "Control"))

saint <- map_dfr(F_SAINT_SET, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
build_bait_long <- function(saint, bait_nonrisk, bait_risk, preys = NULL) {
  d <- saint %>% filter(Bait %in% c(bait_nonrisk, bait_risk))
  if (!is.null(preys)) d <- d %>% filter(PreyGene %in% preys)
  d <- d %>% mutate(status = if_else(Bait == bait_nonrisk, "Nonrisk", "Risk"),
                    Spec_list = str_split(Spec, "\\|"), ctrl_list = str_split(ctrlCounts, "\\|"))
  spec_long <- d %>% select(status, PreyGene, Spec_list) %>% unnest_longer(Spec_list) %>%
    transmute(PreyGene, value = as.numeric(Spec_list), group = status)
  ctrl_long <- d %>% select(status, PreyGene, ctrl_list) %>% unnest_longer(ctrl_list) %>%
    transmute(PreyGene, value = as.numeric(ctrl_list), group = "Control")
  bind_rows(spec_long, ctrl_long) %>% mutate(value = replace_na(value, 0)) %>%
    tidyr::complete(PreyGene, group = c("Nonrisk", "Risk", "Control"), fill = list(value = 0))
}
# bait names as they appear in the SAINT output (gene-PB accession)
itga1_all_long <- build_bait_long(saint, "ITGA1-PB5448-2", "ITGA1-PB5448-10",
                                  preys = c("ITGB1", "ITM2B", "ITM2C", "ITGA1_PB_5448_2"))
mlx_all_long   <- build_bait_long(saint, "MLX-PB-15434-10", "MLX-PB-15434-2")
cat(sprintf("SRP preys: %d | ITGA1 rows: %d | MLX rows: %d\n",
            n_distinct(srp_all_long$PreyGene), nrow(itga1_all_long), nrow(mlx_all_long)))
```

## 6b, 6c, 6g, 6h, 6l, 6m — spectral-count panels (bars = mean, points = replicates)

```{r fig6_apms_panels, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
GRP_COL <- c(Nonrisk = COL_PANEL$nonrisk, Risk = COL_PANEL$risk, Control = COL_PANEL$neutral)
GRP_LV  <- c("Nonrisk", "Risk", "Control")

apms_prey_panel <- function(df, preys, title = NULL, name = "apms_panel", test = "t", w = NULL, h = 1, prey_labels = NULL) {
  d <- df %>% filter(PreyGene %in% preys) %>%
    mutate(PreyGene = factor(PreyGene, levels = preys), group = factor(group, levels = GRP_LV))
  if (!is.null(prey_labels)) levels(d$PreyGene) <- dplyr::recode(levels(d$PreyGene), !!!prey_labels)
  stat <- d %>% filter(group %in% c("Nonrisk", "Risk")) %>%
    group_by(PreyGene) %>%
    summarise(p = tryCatch(if (test == "wilcox") wilcox.test(value ~ droplevels(group))$p.value
                           else t.test(value ~ droplevels(group))$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = star(p))
  ymax  <- d %>% group_by(PreyGene) %>% summarise(y = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  stat  <- stat %>% left_join(ymax, by = "PreyGene") %>% mutate(y = pmax(y, 1))
  means <- d %>% group_by(PreyGene, group) %>% summarise(m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(data = means, aes(group, m, fill = group), width = 0.68, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.14, height = 0, size = 0.4, alpha = 0.75, colour = "grey15") +
    geom_segment(data = stat, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y * 1.08, yend = y * 1.08), linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = stat, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = 1.5, y = y * 1.3, label = label), size = sz(7)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GRP_COL, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Protein Abundance\n(PSM)", title = title) +
    theme_cell(7) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 6), axis.title.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.9),
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
  if (length(preys) > 1)
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~ PreyGene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 5.5), strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5))
  if (is.null(w)) w <- max(1.5, 0.9 * length(preys) + 0.8)
  save_fig(p, name, w, h); print(p); invisible(p)
}

apms_prey_panel(srp_all_long, "SRP54", title = "SRP54 (Bait)", name = "Fig6b_SRP54_bait", w = 1.2)
apms_prey_panel(srp_all_long, c("SRP14", "SRP19", "SRP68", "SRP72", "SRP9"),
                title = "SRP Complex Members (Interactors)", name = "Fig6c_SRP_complex", w = 3)
apms_prey_panel(mlx_all_long, "MLX",   title = "MLX (Bait)",         name = "Fig6g_MLX_bait", w = 1.9)
apms_prey_panel(mlx_all_long, "MLXIP", title = "MLXIP (Interactor)", name = "Fig6h_MLXIP",    w = 1.9)
apms_prey_panel(itga1_all_long, "ITGA1_PB_5448_2", title = "ITGA1 (Bait)", name = "Fig6l_ITGA1_bait", w = 1.9,
                prey_labels = c("ITGA1_PB_5448_2" = "ITGA1"))
apms_prey_panel(itga1_all_long, "ITGB1", title = "ITGB1 (Interactor)", name = "Fig6m_ITGB1", w = 1.9)
```

## AP-MS statistics for the text, the Fig. 6 legend and Supplementary Table 19

The same two-sided Welch's t-test as the panels, so the numbers and the stars agree,
with BH correction within each bait (six preys for SRP54, two each for MLX and ITGA1).

```{r fig6_apms_stats, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
apms_stats <- function(d, bait_label, preys = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(preys)) d <- d %>% filter(PreyGene %in% preys)
  d <- d %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = GRP_LV))
  means <- d %>% group_by(PreyGene, group) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(mean, sd, n), names_glue = "{group}_{.value}")
  tests <- d %>% filter(group %in% c("Nonrisk", "Risk")) %>%
    group_by(PreyGene) %>%
    summarise(p_welch = tryCatch(t.test(value ~ droplevels(group))$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(q_welch = p.adjust(p_welch, "BH"))
  means %>% left_join(tests, by = "PreyGene") %>%
    mutate(bait = bait_label, sig = star(p_welch), risk_above_control = Risk_mean > Control_mean) %>%
    relocate(bait, PreyGene) %>% arrange(p_welch)
}
srp_stats   <- apms_stats(srp_all_long,   "SRP54", c("SRP9", "SRP14", "SRP19", "SRP54", "SRP68", "SRP72"))
mlx_stats   <- apms_stats(mlx_all_long,   "MLX",   c("MLX", "MLXIP"))
itga1_stats <- apms_stats(itga1_all_long, "ITGA1", c("ITGA1_PB_5448_2", "ITGB1")) %>%
  mutate(PreyGene = dplyr::recode(PreyGene, "ITGA1_PB_5448_2" = "ITGA1"))
apms_focus_stats <- bind_rows(srp_stats, mlx_stats, itga1_stats)
print(apms_focus_stats %>% select(bait, PreyGene, Nonrisk_mean, Risk_mean, Control_mean, Nonrisk_n, Risk_n, Control_n, p_welch, q_welch, sig), width = Inf)
write_excel_csv(apms_focus_stats, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "SuppTable_APMS_focus_locus_stats.csv"))
```

## 6r, 6s, 6t and Extended Data 8d, 8e, 8g — ITGA1 spheroid metrics

Per-spheroid mechanics (raw Young's modulus, raw shear modulus, deformation ratio and
circularity, with the experimental batch) come from the compression workbook; fold
change is `value / mean(empty-vector control of the same batch)`, so that batch-to-batch
differences in absolute stiffness do not enter the comparison. Fig. 6s and 6t show the
batch-normalized moduli; the raw Young's modulus is shown in Extended Data Fig. 8e.
Actin/membrane and collagen SHG come from the imaging workbook. Pairwise comparisons
are two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, BH-corrected across the three comparisons, with
a permutation test alongside as a robustness check (Supplementary Table 20).

```{r fig6rst_ED8_spheroid, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_IMAGING, F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_MECH)
YOUNGS_UNIT <- "kPa"

norm_cond <- function(x) { x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(str_detect(x, "trunc") ~ "Risk (OE)", str_detect(x, "can") ~ "Nonrisk (OE)",
                   str_detect(x, "cont") ~ "Empty vector (Ctrl)", TRUE ~ str_to_title(x)) }
COND_LV  <- c("Empty vector (Ctrl)", "Nonrisk (OE)", "Risk (OE)")
COND_COL <- c("Empty vector (Ctrl)" = COL_PANEL$neutral, "Nonrisk (OE)" = COL_PANEL$nonrisk, "Risk (OE)" = COL_PANEL$risk)

# The batch column holds the experiment date as an unpadded integer (mddyy), so the
# three batches are mapped explicitly.
BATCH_DATES <- c(`41125` = "2025-04-11", `52725` = "2025-05-27", `6225` = "2025-06-02")
parse_batch <- function(x) { k <- as.character(as.integer(x))
  stopifnot("unknown batch code in the compression workbook" = all(k %in% names(BATCH_DATES)))
  as.Date(unname(BATCH_DATES[k])) }

# per-spheroid mechanics (columns B:K of the first sheet; header on row 3)
crush <- read_excel(F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_MECH, sheet = 1, range = cell_limits(c(3, 2), c(NA, 11))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Youngs)) %>%
  transmute(cond  = norm_cond(Type), batch = parse_batch(Date), spheroid = as.integer(`#`),
            youngs_raw = as.numeric(Youngs), shear_raw = as.numeric(Shear),
            deformation = as.numeric(Def), circularity = as.numeric(Circ)) %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = COND_LV))
cat(sprintf("spheroids %d | batches %d\n", nrow(crush), n_distinct(crush$batch)))
stopifnot("expected 20 control, 24 nonrisk and 25 risk spheroids" = all(table(crush$cond) == c(20, 24, 25)))

ctrl_mean <- crush %>% filter(cond == "Empty vector (Ctrl)") %>% group_by(batch) %>%
  summarise(youngs_ctrl = mean(youngs_raw), shear_ctrl = mean(shear_raw), .groups = "drop")
crush <- crush %>% left_join(ctrl_mean, by = "batch") %>%
  mutate(youngs_fc = youngs_raw / youngs_ctrl, shear_fc = shear_raw / shear_ctrl)

actin <- read_excel(F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_IMAGING, sheet = "Actin per Membrane Scan"); names(actin)[1:2] <- c("Type", "value")
shg   <- read_excel(F_ITGA1_SPHEROID_IMAGING, sheet = "SHG")
itga1_all <- bind_rows(
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = youngs_raw,  metric = paste0("Young's modulus (", YOUNGS_UNIT, ")")),
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = youngs_fc,   metric = "Young's modulus (FC)"),
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = shear_raw,   metric = paste0("Shear modulus (", YOUNGS_UNIT, ")")),
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = shear_fc,    metric = "Shear modulus (FC)"),
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = circularity, metric = "Spheroid circularity"),
  crush %>% transmute(cond, batch, value = deformation, metric = "Deformation ratio"),
  actin %>% transmute(cond = norm_cond(Type), batch = as.Date(NA), value = as.numeric(value), metric = "Actin / Membrane"),
  shg   %>% transmute(cond = norm_cond(Type), batch = as.Date(NA), value = as.numeric(Value), metric = "Collagen (SHG)")
) %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>% mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = COND_LV))

perm_p <- function(x, y, nperm = 5000) {
  obs <- abs(mean(x) - mean(y)); comb <- c(x, y); n1 <- length(x)
  d <- replicate(nperm, { s <- sample(comb); abs(mean(s[1:n1]) - mean(s[-(1:n1)])) })
  (sum(d >= obs) + 1) / (nperm + 1)
}
pairwise_stats <- function(d) {
  cs <- levels(droplevels(d$cond))
  combn(cs, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    lapply(function(pr) { x <- d$value[d$cond == pr[1]]; y <- d$value[d$cond == pr[2]]
      tibble(g1 = pr[1], g2 = pr[2], n1 = length(x), n2 = length(y),
             median1 = median(x), median2 = median(y),
             p_wilcox = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value), p_perm = perm_p(x, y)) }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>% mutate(p_wilcox_BH = p.adjust(p_wilcox, "BH"))
}

metric_panel <- function(metric_name, ylab, title, ref_line = NA_real_, name) {
  d <- itga1_all %>% filter(metric == metric_name) %>% droplevels()
  st <- pairwise_stats(d)
  yr <- diff(range(d$value)); ymax <- max(d$value)
  sig <- st %>% filter(p_wilcox_BH < 0.05) %>% arrange(match(g1, COND_LV), match(g2, COND_LV))
  xi <- setNames(seq_along(COND_LV), COND_LV)
  base_y <- ymax + 0.06 * yr; step <- 0.10 * yr; brackets <- list()
  if (nrow(sig) > 0) for (k in seq_len(nrow(sig))) {
    x1 <- xi[[sig$g1[k]]]; x2 <- xi[[sig$g2[k]]]; yy <- base_y + (k - 1) * step
    brackets <- c(brackets, list(
      annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = yy, yend = yy, linewidth = 0.3),
      annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = yy, yend = yy - 0.02 * yr, linewidth = 0.3),
      annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = yy, yend = yy - 0.02 * yr, linewidth = 0.3),
      annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = yy + 0.01 * yr, label = star(sig$p_wilcox_BH[k]), size = sz(8), vjust = 0)))
  }
  top <- if (nrow(sig) > 0) base_y + nrow(sig) * step else ymax + 0.08 * yr
  ylo <- min(d$value) - 0.05 * yr
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(cond, value))
  if (!is.na(ref_line)) p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = ref_line, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60")
  p <- p +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = cond), width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey25") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.14, height = 0, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5, colour = "grey20") +
    brackets +
    scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" \\(", "\n(", x)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(ylo, top + 0.03 * yr), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme_cell(BASE_SIZE)
  save_fig(p, name, 2, 2); print(p); invisible(p)
}

set.seed(1)   # permutation test
metric_panel("Spheroid circularity", "Spheroid circularity",          "Circularity",     name = "Fig6r_circularity")
metric_panel("Shear modulus (FC)",   "Shear modulus (fold change)",   "Shear modulus",   ref_line = 1, name = "Fig6s_shear_modulus")
metric_panel("Young's modulus (FC)", "Young's modulus (fold change)", "Young's modulus", ref_line = 1, name = "Fig6t_youngs_modulus")
metric_panel("Actin / Membrane",     "Actin / Membrane (a.u.)",       "Actin / Membrane", name = "ED8d_actin_membrane")
metric_panel(paste0("Young's modulus (", YOUNGS_UNIT, ")"), paste0("Young's modulus (", YOUNGS_UNIT, ")"),
             "Young's modulus (raw)", name = "ED8e_youngs_modulus_raw")
metric_panel("Collagen (SHG)",       "Collagen SHG (a.u.)",           "Collagen",        name = "ED8g_collagen_SHG")

itga1_stats_all <- itga1_all %>% distinct(metric) %>% pull(metric) %>%
  set_names() %>% map_dfr(~ pairwise_stats(filter(itga1_all, metric == .x)), .id = "metric")
write_csv(itga1_stats_all, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "itga1_spheroid_pairwise_stats.csv"))
```


# Supplementary Tables

Numbering follows the manuscript workbook: S8 AP-MS bait constructs, S10 SQANTI
classifications, S11 GENCODE versus VSMC repertoire, S12 peptide evidence, S13 CAD
sQTL junction master, S14 AS event classification, S15 property statistics (written by
script 03 and copied here), S16 risk/nonrisk pairs, S17 AP-MS interactions, S18 GO
terms, S19 vignette statistics, S20 spheroid measurements. Tables S1–S7 and S9
(colocalization, LD, SpliceAI/VEP, primers, ESE, ELISA) are assembled from the deposited
source data outside this script.

```{r tables_setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
put <- function(d, n, name) {
  f <- file.path(SUPP_DIR, sprintf("TableS%02d_%s.csv", n, name))
  write_excel_csv(d, f)
  cat(sprintf("S%-2d  %-46s %5d rows x %2d cols\n", n, name, nrow(d), ncol(d)))
  invisible(f)
}
```

## S8 — AP-MS bait constructs

One row per bait (26 rows: 13 genes × risk/nonrisk): gene, isoform role, PB accession,
ENST (only for FSM/ISM isoforms; blank = novel), SQANTI transcript and protein
categories, length and protein sequence.

```{r tableS08_baits, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS, F_APMS_BAIT_FASTA)
suppressMessages(library(Biostrings))

bait <- read_csv(F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(~ sub("^﻿", "", .x))
gene_col    <- grep("Gene",  names(bait), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
risk_col    <- grep("^risk", names(bait), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
nonrisk_col <- grep("^non",  names(bait), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
desc_col    <- grep("Descr", names(bait), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(risk_col), !is.na(nonrisk_col))
baits_long <- bait %>%
  transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], description = if (!is.na(desc_col)) .data[[desc_col]] else NA_character_,
            risk = str_extract(.data[[risk_col]], "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
            nonrisk = str_extract(.data[[nonrisk_col]], "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(risk, nonrisk), names_to = "isoform_role", values_to = "pb_id") %>%
  mutate(isoform_role = factor(isoform_role, levels = c("risk", "nonrisk"))) %>%
  arrange(gene, isoform_role)
stopifnot("bait without a PB accession" = !any(is.na(baits_long$pb_id)))

sq_slim <- rna %>%
  transmute(pb_id = isoform, enst_id = associated_transcript, sqanti_transcript_category = structural_category) %>%
  mutate(enst_id = ifelse(enst_id %in% c("novel", "NA", ""), NA_character_, enst_id))
psub_col <- intersect(c("pr_splice_subcat", "protein_classification_subset"), names(prot))[1]
sp_slim <- prot %>%
  transmute(pb_id = pb, sqanti_protein_category = pr_splice_cat,
            sqanti_protein_subcategory = if (!is.na(psub_col)) .data[[psub_col]] else NA_character_)

fa <- Biostrings::readAAStringSet(F_APMS_BAIT_FASTA)
fa_tbl <- tibble(header = names(fa), sequence = as.character(fa), aa_length = Biostrings::width(fa)) %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(header, "PB[._-][0-9]+[._-][0-9]+"), pb_id = gsub("[_-]", ".", pb_id))

supp_baits <- baits_long %>%
  left_join(sq_slim, by = "pb_id") %>%
  left_join(sp_slim, by = "pb_id") %>%
  left_join(fa_tbl %>% filter(!is.na(pb_id)) %>% select(pb_id, sequence, aa_length), by = "pb_id") %>%
  select(gene, description, isoform_role, pb_id, enst_id, sqanti_transcript_category,
         sqanti_protein_category, sqanti_protein_subcategory, aa_length, sequence)
stopifnot("expected 26 bait constructs" = nrow(supp_baits) == 26,
          "bait sequence not found in the FASTA" = !any(is.na(supp_baits$sequence)))
put(supp_baits, 8, "APMS_bait_constructs")
```

## S11 — GENCODE versus VSMC transcript repertoire, per gene

Two GENCODE denominators (all transcripts / protein-coding only) and two VSMC
definitions (FSM only / FSM + ISM), for all VSMC-expressed genes and for the CAD sGenes.
The summary table gives the medians quoted in the Results.

```{r tableS11_gencode_vs_vsmc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
require_files(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF)
gtf <- data.table::fread(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", skip = "##", showProgress = FALSE)
gencode_tx <- gtf[V3 == "transcript",
  .(gene_id = str_extract(V9, '(?<=gene_id ")[^"]+'), symbol = str_extract(V9, '(?<=gene_name ")[^"]+'),
    tx_id = str_extract(V9, '(?<=transcript_id ")[^"]+'), tx_type = str_extract(V9, '(?<=transcript_type ")[^"]+'))] |> as_tibble()
rm(gtf); gc(verbose = FALSE)
gencode_n <- gencode_tx %>% group_by(gene_id, symbol) %>%
  summarise(n_gencode = n_distinct(tx_id), n_gencode_pc = n_distinct(tx_id[tx_type == "protein_coding"]), .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("GENCODE v38: %s genes | %s transcripts | %s protein-coding\n",
            comma(nrow(gencode_n)), comma(sum(gencode_n$n_gencode)), comma(sum(gencode_n$n_gencode_pc))))

vsmc <- rna_expr %>%
  filter(!is.na(associated_gene)) %>%
  group_by(gene_id = associated_gene) %>%
  summarise(n_vsmc = n(),
            n_fsm     = n_distinct(associated_transcript[structural_category == "full-splice_match" &
                                                         !is.na(associated_transcript) & associated_transcript != "novel"]),
            n_fsm_ism = n_distinct(associated_transcript[structural_category %in% cat_known &
                                                         !is.na(associated_transcript) & associated_transcript != "novel"]),
            n_novel = sum(structural_category %in% cat_novel), .groups = "drop")
rep_tbl <- vsmc %>% inner_join(gencode_n, by = "gene_id") %>% relocate(symbol, .after = gene_id) %>%
  mutate(frac_fsm = n_fsm / n_gencode, frac_fsm_ism = n_fsm_ism / n_gencode,
         frac_fsm_pc = ifelse(n_gencode_pc > 0, n_fsm / n_gencode_pc, NA_real_),
         frac_fsm_ism_pc = ifelse(n_gencode_pc > 0, n_fsm_ism / n_gencode_pc, NA_real_))
sgenes <- unique(lfc_m$gene_name)
sg_tbl <- rep_tbl %>% filter(symbol %in% sgenes)
cat(sprintf("genes analysed: %s | CAD sGenes matched: %d of %d\n", comma(nrow(rep_tbl)), nrow(sg_tbl), length(sgenes)))

fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f [%.0f-%.0f]", median(x, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x, .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x, .75, na.rm = TRUE))
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f-%.1f%%]", 100 * median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * quantile(x, .25, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * quantile(x, .75, na.rm = TRUE))
make_summary <- function(d, label) tibble(
  Measure = c("GENCODE transcripts per gene", "GENCODE protein-coding transcripts per gene",
              "VSMC isoforms detected per gene (all)", "  of which annotated, exact match (FSM)",
              "  of which annotated, exact or partial (FSM+ISM)", "  of which novel (NIC/NNC)",
              "GENCODE repertoire detected, exact match", "GENCODE repertoire detected, exact or partial",
              "Protein-coding repertoire detected, exact match", "Protein-coding repertoire detected, exact or partial"),
  !!label := c(fmt(d$n_gencode), fmt(d$n_gencode_pc), fmt(d$n_vsmc), fmt(d$n_fsm), fmt(d$n_fsm_ism), fmt(d$n_novel),
               pct(d$frac_fsm), pct(d$frac_fsm_ism), pct(d$frac_fsm_pc), pct(d$frac_fsm_ism_pc)))
summary_tbl <- make_summary(rep_tbl, sprintf("All genes (n = %s)", comma(nrow(rep_tbl)))) %>%
  left_join(make_summary(sg_tbl, sprintf("CAD sGenes (n = %d)", nrow(sg_tbl))), by = "Measure")
print(as.data.frame(summary_tbl), row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
write_excel_csv(summary_tbl, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "TableS11_gencode_vs_vsmc_summary.csv"))
put(rep_tbl, 11, "gencode_vs_vsmc_repertoire_per_gene")
```

## S17 — AP-MS high-confidence interactions, with VSMC support

The BioGRID flag and the CAD GWAS annotation of each interactor (most likely causal
genes of Aragam et al., 2022) are carried from the network table of script 07.

```{r tableS17_apms_interactions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bg_col   <- grep("biogrid", names(network), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
gwas_col <- grep("aragam", names(network), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
stopifnot("no BioGRID column found in the network table" = length(bg_col) >= 1,
          "no Aragam CAD GWAS column found in the network table" = length(gwas_col) >= 1)
sup_tbl <- read_csv(OUT_PREY_VSMC_SUPPORT, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^﻿", "", .x)) %>%
  filter(!Bait %in% "RAB11B-3xFLAG") %>%
  distinct(PreyGene, In_SMCs_in_HPA, `SMC Protein`, `SMC LR RNAseq`) %>%
  transmute(prey = display_gene(PreyGene),
            interactor_in_HPA_SMC = In_SMCs_in_HPA, interactor_in_VSMC_protein = `SMC Protein`,
            interactor_in_VSMC_longread = `SMC LR RNAseq`,
            n_VSMC_measures_supporting = (In_SMCs_in_HPA == "YES") + (`SMC Protein` == "YES") + (`SMC LR RNAseq` == "YES"))
s17 <- network %>%
  transmute(bait = display_gene(source_harmonized), prey = target_harmonized, specificity,
            PSM_risk, PSM_nonrisk, log2FC_PSM, in_biogrid = .data[[bg_col[1]]],
            interactor_in_Aragam_CAD_GWAS = .data[[gwas_col[1]]]) %>%
  left_join(sup_tbl, by = "prey") %>%
  distinct(bait, prey, specificity, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(bait, desc(abs(log2FC_PSM)))
cat(sprintf("S17: %d interactions | %d baits | %d distinct prey | %d in BioGRID\n",
            nrow(s17), n_distinct(s17$bait), n_distinct(s17$prey),
            sum(s17$in_biogrid %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "YES"))))
put(s17, 17, "APMS_interactions_with_VSMC_support")
```

## S20 — spheroid measurements and pairwise tests

One sheet: per-spheroid values with batch (raw and fold-change moduli both kept so that a
reader can redo the normalization), a blank row, then the pairwise tests under their own
header.

```{r tableS20_spheroid, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
meas <- itga1_all %>% mutate(batch = format(batch, "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  select(metric, condition = cond, batch, value) %>% arrange(metric, condition, batch)
stats <- itga1_stats_all %>%
  select(metric, group_1 = g1, group_2 = g2, n_1 = n1, n_2 = n2, median_1 = median1, median_2 = median2,
         p_wilcoxon = p_wilcox, p_wilcoxon_BH = p_wilcox_BH, p_permutation = p_perm)
cat(sprintf("S20: %d measurements | %d metrics | %d conditions | %d pairwise tests\n",
            nrow(meas), n_distinct(meas$metric), n_distinct(meas$condition), nrow(stats)))

as_chr <- function(d) mutate(d, across(everything(), ~ as.character(.x)))
pad <- function(d, n) { for (i in seq_len(max(0, n - ncol(d)))) d[[paste0("pad", i)]] <- ""; d }
w <- max(ncol(meas), ncol(stats))
block_a <- pad(as_chr(meas), w)
block_b <- pad(bind_rows(as_chr(stats)[0, ] %>% add_row(!!!setNames(as.list(names(stats)), names(stats))),
                         as_chr(stats)), w)
names(block_b) <- names(block_a)
blank_row <- block_a[0, ] %>% add_row()
title_row <- blank_row
title_row[[1]] <- "Pairwise tests (two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH-corrected across the three comparisons; permutation test as robustness check)"
s20 <- bind_rows(block_a, blank_row, title_row, block_b) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")))
names(s20)[str_detect(names(s20), "^pad")] <- ""
put(s20, 20, "ITGA1_spheroid_measurements_and_tests")
```

## Manifest of the Supplementary Table files

```{r tables_manifest, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
man <- tibble(file = list.files(SUPP_DIR, pattern = "^TableS.*\\.csv$")) %>%
  mutate(path = file.path(SUPP_DIR, file),
         n_rows = map_int(path, ~ nrow(read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))),
         n_cols = map_int(path, ~ ncol(read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)))) %>%
  select(-path)
print(as.data.frame(man), row.names = FALSE)
write_excel_csv(man, file.path(SUPP_DIR, "TABLE_MANIFEST.csv"))
```
